description:
About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle, from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.


The Role

The UI Designer is a key contributor to Lilo Social's conversion rate optimization practice, responsible for designing high-performing Shopify storefronts and direct-response landing pages for a portfolio of 8- and 9-figure DTC brands. This role sits at the intersection of aesthetics and performance, translating CRO strategy, A/B test hypotheses, and brand guidelines into polished, conversion-optimized digital experiences. You will work closely with CRO strategists, developers, and client partners to bring designs from concept to implementation with precision and speed.


What Success Looks Like

  • Measurable improvements in CVR, AOV, and on-site engagement metrics across your client portfolio
  • High-quality design deliverables that are executed on-brief, on-brand, and on deadline
  • A consistent output of test-ready page variations that support an active A/B testing roadmap
  • Strong cross-functional relationships with CRO strategists and developers that accelerate design-to-launch velocity


Responsibilities

  • Design Shopify storefront experiences including homepages, product detail pages, collection pages, and cart/checkout flows optimized for conversion
  • Develop high-converting landing pages for paid media campaigns, promotional offers, and subscription acquisition
  • Translate CRO hypotheses and A/B test briefs into polished, production-ready design mockups using Figma
  • Apply direct response design principles to every deliverable, balancing visual quality with performance intent
  • Collaborate with CRO strategists to understand test objectives, user behavior data, and optimization priorities before beginning design work
  • Iterate rapidly on design concepts based on A/B test results, heatmap analysis, and qualitative feedback
  • Maintain and evolve client-specific design systems and component libraries in Figma to ensure brand consistency at scale
  • Handoff designs to developers with annotated specs, interaction notes, and responsive behavior defined
  • Review implemented pages against design intent and provide precise QA feedback prior to launch
  • Participate in client-facing design reviews and communicate design rationale clearly and professionally
  • Stay current on DTC eCommerce design trends, Shopify theme capabilities, and emerging CRO best practices


Requirements

  • 3+ years of UI design experience, with a portfolio demonstrating Shopify storefront and landing page work for eCommerce brands
  • Expert proficiency in Figma, including component libraries, auto layout, and developer handoff workflows
  • Deep understanding of direct response design principles and how layout, hierarchy, copy placement, and visual cues drive conversion
  • Proven experience designing within or alongside A/B testing frameworks (Intelligems, Convert, VWO, Optimizely, or similar)
  • Strong understanding of responsive design and mobile-first design principles
  • Ability to interpret quantitative data (CVR, bounce rate, scroll depth, heatmaps) and translate insights into design decisions
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to present and defend design decisions to internal teams and client stakeholders


Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with Shopify theme structure, Liquid templating, or experience working directly within Shopify Online Store 2.0
  • Experience with tools such as Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, Google Optimize, or similar UX research and testing platforms
  • Basic proficiency in HTML/CSS sufficient to support developer QA and minor implementation edits
  • Background in DTC subscription brands or experience designing subscription-specific UX (subscribe-and-save, upsell flows, portal pages)
  • Motion or micro-interaction design experience using Figma prototyping or After Effects


Compensation and Benefits

  • Generous Time Off: Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Fully Remote: Work from anywhere with flexible hours and a distributed team culture
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Forensic Manager
description:
This leading multinational group, with significant operations across the Americas and worldwide, is seeking an experienced Forensic Manager to lead a team of corporate investigators across their regional operations.


Based in Belo Horizonte, you will be responsible for managing a team of forensic specialists who are overseeing investigations into complex financial crimes, including conflict-of-interest, procurement fraud, misappropriation of assets, corruption, and bribery.


Your role will be primarily focused on team leadership, setting key performance objectives, and building strategic relationships to ensure seamless regional operations. You will have day-to-day responsibility for managing forensic specialists, providing career development guidance, and overseeing resource allocation. Furthermore, you will serve as the primary point of contact for operational management while playing a key role in the overall strategic management of the group’s investigative objectives.


In addition to your leadership duties, you will undertake high-level corporate investigation projects, conduct fraud awareness training, and oversee the integration of data analytics into investigative workflows.


To be successful in this role, you should possess extensive experience in leading complex corporate investigations and managing specialized forensic teams. You are likely currently working in a managerial capacity within a forensic advisory firm or a comparable corporate business.


While a CFE qualification is highly welcomed, we value your proven ability to lead high-performance teams and manage senior stakeholder relationships. Excellent communication skills are essential, and candidates must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. Proficiency in Spanish and experience with advanced data analytics tools are welcomed.


For more information, please see our video

title: Data Analyst
description:
Company: Fraud Deflect


Role: Data Analyst


Language: Native/fluent English. Resumes in English.


About the role

Help Fraud Deflect turn data into clear, reliable insights across fraud, chargebacks, alerts, and operational performance. The focus is working within the current stack to improve reporting, analysis, data quality, and decision-making, not rebuilding everything from scratch.


Responsibilities

  • Own reporting and analysis for core business datasets.
  • Build and maintain dashboards, recurring reports, and KPI tracking.
  • Write and optimize SQL for analysis, reporting, and data validation.
  • Analyze fraud, chargeback, dispute, and merchant trends to identify risks, patterns, and opportunities.
  • Investigate anomalies, data issues, and performance changes across key metrics.
  • Partner with engineering, product, operations, and leadership to answer business questions with data.
  • Work with existing pipelines and datasets to improve trust, consistency, and usability of data.
  • Use Python for analysis, validation, and lightweight automation where needed.
  • Support data quality efforts by identifying gaps, inconsistencies, and edge cases in source data.
  • Create clear visualizations and communicate findings in a practical, business-friendly way.
  • Work within the current stack (MySQL, AWS, Airflow; ClickHouse is a plus).


Required

  • Strong MySQL/SQL skills.
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving.
  • Experience building dashboards and reports.
  • Ability to translate business questions into clear analysis.
  • Experience working with production data and validating data quality.
  • Python proficiency for analysis or automation.
  • Strong communication and troubleshooting skills.
  • Comfortable working with existing systems and improving them incrementally.


Nice to have

  • Experience with fraud, payments, chargebacks, disputes, or risk data.
  • Experience with Airflow or other scheduled workflow tools.
  • AWS experience.
  • Observability/visualization experience (metrics, dashboards, alerting).
  • Prior ClickHouse experience.
  • Basic Linux/CLI comfort.


How to apply

Send an English resume and links to APIs/code/docs showing Python, Clickhouse, SQL, automation, and payments/chargebacks work.

Somos uma consultoria de tecnologia que atua no desenvolvimento de soluções digitais para diferentes contextos e desafios de negócio. Estamos em constante crescimento e, por isso, abrimos este Banco de Talentos para profissionais de tecnologia que queiram fazer parte do nosso radar para oportunidades atuais e futuras.


Este não é um processo seletivo para uma vaga única e imediata, mas sim um banco de talentos estratégico. Nosso objetivo é conhecer profissionais que atuam ou desejam atuar em projetos 100% remotos , para que possamos entrar em contato assim que surgirem oportunidades alinhadas ao seu perfil.


Se avançarmos na conversa, você poderá ser convidado(a) a completar seu cadastro em nossa plataforma de oportunidades, o Enter , para conhecermos melhor sua trajetória e interesses profissionais. /


Perfis que buscamos com frequência:

  • Desenvolvedores(as) Java (Pleno e Sênior);
  • Desenvolvedores(as) .NET;
  • Desenvolvedores(as) Fullstack;
  • Outros perfis em desenvolvimento de software também são bem-vindos.


O que pode acontecer após sua candidatura?

  • Sua candidatura ficará ativa em nosso banco de talentos;
  • Quando surgirem novas oportunidades, entraremos em contato;
  • Algumas vagas podem ser 100% remotas e outras em modelo híbrido , conforme a necessidade do projeto;
  • Caso uma posição remota seja encerrada, poderemos te convidar para conversar sobre outras oportunidades compatíveis com seu perfil.


O que buscamos em nossos talentos:

  • Boa base técnica na sua stack de atuação;
  • Interesse em atuar em ambientes colaborativos e dinâmicos;
  • Comunicação clara e vontade de evoluir constantemente;
  • Experiência prévia na área será considerada conforme o nível da vaga.


✨ Se você busca visibilidade, novas oportunidades e fazer parte de uma empresa de tecnologia em expansão, esse banco de talentos é para você.


Candidate-se e venha fazer parte do nosso ecossistema de tecnologia!


Benefícios e Incentivos: Saúde e Bem-estar: Assistências Médica e Odontológica (SulAmérica), Seguro de Vida (Prudential), Previdência Privada (Onze) e acesso ao WellHub para cuidar da mente e do corpo, além de VR Caju.


Desenvolvimento: Coparticipação na assinatura do Alura, ajuda para cursos de inglês, Ciclo de Avaliação de Desempenho com Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI), e programas internos de mentoria e capacitação profissional.


Equilíbrio: Com nosso benefício de Antecipação de Férias, quem tem entre 6 e 12 meses de contrato pode aproveitar o descanso sem perder esse direito ao mudar de emprego.


Diversidade e Inclusão: Todas as nossas oportunidades são elegíveis para pessoas com deficiência.


Sobre a Elumini Somos uma consultoria sólida no mercado de TI, com operações na América do Sul, América do Norte e Europa. Certificada pelo Great Place to Work®, somos reconhecidos por nossa forma única de valorizar profissionais e promover um ambiente diferenciado.

title: Engenheiro(a) de Software Backend - Especialista
description:
O seu papel como Especialista em Engenharia de Software Backend será:

  • Desenvolver programação do início ao fim, incluindo definições de arquitetura, testes e rollout em produção;
  • Liderança no desenvolvimento de projetos com arquitetura de microserviços, consumo e geração de eventos em Streaming, API's;
  • Garantir a funcionalidade, manutenibilidade e velocidade, além de práticas de teste e qualidade;
  • Atuar como referência técnica dentro do time, atuando como mentor de pares de menor senioridade;
  • Garantir que todas as soluções técnicas estejam alinhadas a estratégia do negócio e entender iniciativas relacionadas ao produto;
  • Ajudar o time no desenho de soluções com arquitetura evolutiva, além de investigar constantemente novas tecnologias e formas de trabalho;
  • Colaborar com a evolução das habilidades técnicas do time e esforços de melhoria contínua que impactam vários times;
  • Trabalhar em um ambiente colaborativo, em que práticas de pareamento, feedbacks e motivação para se desenvolver são comuns a todos os squads.


O que você precisa para essa posição no jogo:

  • Conhecimento avançado em desenvolvimento em Golang ou Typescript ;
  • Conhecimento sobre desenvolvimento de consumidores e produtores de eventos para Event Streaming (Kafka) ;
  • Conhecimento em Docker & Kubernetes ;
  • Conhecimento com ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade ;
  • Conhecimento sobre testes unitários e de integração;
  • Preocupação com a qualidade e desempenho das soluções propostas;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em um ambiente multifuncional e colaborativo, de maneira autônoma;
  • Conhecimento sobre desenvolvimento e implementação de APIs ;
  • Conhecimento sobre desenvolvimento de microsserviços distribuídos ;
  • Embasamento teórico, habilidade e preocupação com a excelência técnica e boas práticas de desenvolvimento (DDD, Arquitetura, Design de Código, Paradigmas, etc.);
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis.


Seria legal se você conhecesse:

  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento em C# ;
  • Google Cloud Continuous Integration;
  • Continuous Delivery.

title: Salesforce Configuration Specialist
description:
QAT Global, a US-based IT consulting firm with over 30 years of experience, is looking for a Salesforce Configuration Specialist to join our growing team. We are proud to deliver world-class technology solutions with teams across the US, Costa Rica, and Brazil.


This is a full-time, remote position (CLT hire in Brazil only) , offering the chance to collaborate directly with our US-based client and international development teams.


We are seeking a Salesforce Configuration Specialist with strong hands-on experience in complex configurations and data management. This role is focused on delivering scalable, high-quality solutions using declarative tools , with a strong emphasis on Flows, security, and data integrity .


Key Responsibilities

  • Execute advanced Salesforce configurations (Flows, Experience Cloud, automation, custom fields, permissions)
  • Manage data migration and ensure data quality and consistency
  • Translate business requirements into scalable Salesforce solutions
  • Troubleshoot configuration and data reconciliation issues
  • Provide training and create user/technical documentation
  • Build reports and dashboards for operational and leadership insights


Required Experience

  • Solid experience with Salesforce administration and configuration (not only certifications)
  • Strong knowledge of:
  • User management (roles, profiles, permission sets, security policies)
  • Data modeling and object relationships
  • Validation rules, formula fields, record types, list views
  • Flows (advanced level) and troubleshooting
  • Experience with SSO/SAML configuration and authentication setup
  • Proficiency in Data Loader, Data Import Wizard, and data quality management
  • Ability to differentiate data vs. configuration issues and replicate scenarios in sandbox environments
  • Experience building reports and dashboards


Preferred Profile

  • 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce experience
  • Strong communication skills in English (client-facing environment)
  • Analytical mindset with a structured, problem-solving approach
  • Experience in B2B software environments


Nice to Have

  • Knowledge of Apex, Lightning Web Components, or ISV development
  • Experience writing technical specifications


Why Join

  • Work on international projects with global clients
  • Exposure to complex, large-scale Salesforce environments
  • Collaborative and technically driven team


If you have a strong configuration background and can operate at depth without relying on code, this role is aligned with your profile.
company: QAT Global | Custom Software Development & IT Staffing Solutions - US, Brazil & Costa Rica Nearshore

We are seeking a Salesforce Configuration Specialist with strong hands-on experience in complex configurations and data management. This role is focused on delivering scalable, high-quality solutions using declarative tools , with a strong emphasis on Flows, security, and data integrity .


Key Responsibilities

  • Execute advanced Salesforce configurations (Flows, Experience Cloud, automation, custom fields, permissions)
  • Manage data migration and ensure data quality and consistency
  • Translate business requirements into scalable Salesforce solutions
  • Troubleshoot configuration and data reconciliation issues
  • Provide training and create user/technical documentation
  • Build reports and dashboards for operational and leadership insights


Required Experience

  • Solid experience with Salesforce administration and configuration (not only certifications)
  • Strong knowledge of:
  • User management (roles, profiles, permission sets, security policies)
  • Data modeling and object relationships
  • Validation rules, formula fields, record types, list views
  • Flows (advanced level) and troubleshooting
  • Experience with SSO/SAML configuration and authentication setup
  • Proficiency in Data Loader, Data Import Wizard, and data quality management
  • Ability to differentiate data vs. configuration issues and replicate scenarios in sandbox environments
  • Experience building reports and dashboards


Preferred Profile

  • 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce experience
  • Strong communication skills in English (client-facing environment)
  • Analytical mindset with a structured, problem-solving approach
  • Experience in B2B software environments


Nice to Have

  • Knowledge of Apex, Lightning Web Components, or ISV development
  • Experience writing technical specifications


Why Join

  • Work on international projects with global clients
  • Exposure to complex, large-scale Salesforce environments
  • Collaborative and technically driven team


If you have a strong configuration background and can operate at depth without relying on code, this role is aligned with your profile.

title: Pessoa Cientista de Dados - Vaga afirmativa para pessoas LGBTQIAPN+
description:
A vaga atual é para o escritório do Brasil e trabalhamos em um modelo Free Office.

Quem somos:

Nós da Artefact LatAm acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact!

Quais serão suas responsabilidades:

Você se juntará à nossa equipe de Dados e Consultoria, que ajuda os clientes a transformar e melhorar sua estratégia de dados aplicando análises avançadas para gerar insights que criam valor de negócio a partir de big data e inteligência artificial.

  • Inovar . Você trabalhará com sua equipe, composta por consultores, cientistas de dados, e engenheiros, para identificar as necessidades dos clientes e definir soluções inovadoras.
  • Aprender e Compartilhar. Você trabalhará em uma equipe colaborativa que promove o compartilhamento de conhecimento. Você aprenderá com outras pessoas, compartilhará conhecimento e ficará a par das novidades/atualizações do setor.
  • Desenvolver. Você participará da solução do início ao fim. Com o auxílio de cientistas seniores você gerenciará a concepção e a implementação, além de otimizar o desempenho e a escalabilidade.
  • Atuar em toda a cadeia de valor dos projetos (coleta e tratamento de dados, análise exploratória de dados, aplicação de modelos de aprendizado de máquina, produtização de modelos)
  • Popularizar termos técnicos ou soluções para perfis mais orientados a negócios, pode trabalhar em uma equipe com perfis muito diversificados
  • Priorizar suas tarefas, respeitar prazos e se levantar a mão em caso de riscos ou problemas

O que nós estamos procurando:

Ter cursado um curso de graduação em ciência de dados, aprendizado de máquina, matemática, ciência da computação, estatística, engenharia, economia ou uma área relacionada.

  • Desejável um primeiro conhecimento em estatística e programação (Python/R).
  • Curiosidade: você está sempre buscando soluções inovadoras para seus clientes, você está envolvido em toda a cadeia de valor
  • Colaboração : o compartilhamento de conhecimento é essencial para você e você participa ativamente da difusão de informações dentro da Artefact
  • Empreendedorismo : você traz soluções, novas ideias, inovações

O que oferecemos:

  • VR/VT
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
  • Gympass
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós:

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da área de dados.
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender.
  • Cultura: Empatia e Colaboração está no nosso DNA.
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!

Junte-se a nós!

title: Analista de requisitos
description:
Na Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.


Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!


Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!


Requisitos e Qualificações:


Ensino superior completo em TI ou áreas correlatas


Sólida experiência comprovada em atividades de análise e engenharia de requisitos, para especificar requisitos funcionais utilizando diferentes técnicas, como Casos de Uso, cenários de uso e Histórias de Usuário.


Métricas de Software: Habilidade em escrever requisitos orientados à contagem de pontos de função (APF).


Qualidade e Segurança: Especificar requisitos não funcionais, com foco em desenvolvimento confiável, boas práticas de segurança e conformidade com a LGPD (Privacidade e Proteção de Dados).

Gestão de Mudanças: Realizar análise de impacto de mudanças em requisitos já estabelecidos.


UX/UI Inicial: Elaboração de prototipagem para validação de interfaces e fluxos com o usuário, preferencialmente na ferramenta Figma.


Rastreabilidade: Garantir a rastreabilidade horizontal e vertical dos requisitos ao longo do projeto.

Comunicação de Interface: Especificar mensagens de sistema adequadas para a experiência do usuário.

Validação: Conduzir sessões de validação guiada de requisitos com as partes interessadas.


Informações adicionais


Vale alimentação ou vale-refeição;

Desconto em cursos, universidades e instituições de idiomas;

Academia Stefanini — plataforma com cursos on-line, gratuitos, atualizados e com certificado;

Mentoring;

Clube de vantagens para consultas e exames;

Assistência médica;

title: Senior Tax and Accounting Manager
description:
About the Company

We are a high-growth technology company with annual revenue above BRL 300M , operating under an asset-light model and generating recurring revenue . Our operations span Brazil and the United States , and we are continuously evolving our financial and operational processes to support our growth.


About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Tax & Accounting Manager to join our Controllership team and lead the accounting and tax operations for our Brazilian and U.S. entities.

This is a strategic role responsible for ensuring compliance with BR GAAP and US GAAP , managing cross-border tax complexity, and driving process improvements, automation, and operational efficiency across the finance function.

You will lead a team of 4–7 professionals and work closely with leadership, auditors, and international stakeholders.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close under BR GAAP and US GAAP
  • Manage intercompany consolidation , eliminations, and reconciliations
  • Oversee the Brazilian tax operation , including direct and indirect tax calculations and statutory filings (SPED, ECF, ECD, etc.)
  • Coordinate the U.S. tax operation with external advisors
  • Manage transfer pricing processes between group entities
  • Lead the external audit process and act as the main point of contact with Big Four auditors
  • Identify opportunities for process automation and efficiency improvements within NetSuite
  • Explore the use of AI and automation tools to improve reconciliations, financial close, and variance analysis
  • Lead, develop, and mentor the Accounting & Tax team
  • Provide financial insights and reporting to support leadership decision-making


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting with active CRC certification
  • Previous experience at a Big Four audit firm (Deloitte, EY, KPMG, or PwC)
  • 5+ years of corporate experience after Big Four, ideally in high-growth or technology companies
  • Strong knowledge of BR GAAP/IFRS and US GAAP
  • Experience with intercompany consolidation and transfer pricing
  • NetSuite experience as a primary ERP
  • Fluent English (daily interaction with U.S. teams and auditors)
  • Experience leading and developing accounting or tax teams


Nice to Have

  • Strong background in tax and fiscal disciplines
  • Experience with Brazilian tax incentives (Lei do Bem, Lei de Informática)
  • Familiarity with tax automation tools
  • Experience implementing AI or RPA in accounting processes
  • Experience optimizing NetSuite workflows, scripts, or dashboards
  • Postgraduate degree or certifications such as CPA or MBA in Finance


What We’re Looking For

  • Strong ownership mindset and proactive problem-solving
  • Ability to challenge manual processes and drive improvements
  • Comfort working in fast-paced environments with tight deadlines
  • Strong communication skills and ability to translate complex technical topics to leadership
  • Interest in technology, automation, and innovation within finance

title: Especialista de Implantação SAP PY
description:
Na ADP, somos movidos pelo seu sucesso. Envolvemos seus talentos e perspectivas únicos. Acolhemos suas ideias para fazer as coisas de modo diferente e melhor. Nós apoiamos seus esforços para realizar, aprender e crescer. Se o sucesso te motiva, você pertence à ADP.

Nos esforçamos para que cada interação seja motivada pelos nossos valores CENTRAIS: Conhecimento e Visão, Integridade é Tudo, Excelência na Prestação de Serviços, Inovação Inspiradora, Cada Pessoa Conta, Orientação a Resultados e Responsabilidade Social.

Nossa cultura acolhe diversas perspectivas e cria um lugar onde as carreiras podem florescer. Nós respeitamos e valorizamos as diferenças com oportunidades iguais de emprego, independentemente de raça, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, idade, cultura, deficiência ou status social.

Todas as nossas vagas respeitam esse compromisso. Faça parte do nosso time!

RESUMO DA POSIÇÃO


Como Consultor SAP, você atuará como facilitador entre a equipe de implementação e os clientes para entender melhor suas necessidades de negócios.

Atuará também como mentor ou treinador de parceiros. Preparará especificações funcionais, incluindo detalhes sobre design e configuração.

FUNÇÕES:


  • Resolver os problemas reportados nos SLAs.
  • Configuração do SAP HCM PY para folha de pagamento Brasil, Argentina, Colombia e Costa Rica
  • Fornecer aos clientes o status das implementações
  • Guarde a documentação do cliente
  • Fornecer suporte a aplicativos
  • Reunir-se com clientes sempre que necessário
  • Aplicar conhecimento funcional relevante específico do país para potencializar o serviço focado no cliente
  • Realizar testes unitários
  • Fornecer documentação

REQUISITOS:

  • Experiência em implementação SAP HCM, módulo de folha de pagamento (PY)
  • Ensino superior completo
  • Inglês em nível avançado para conversação


O modelo de trabalho adotado pela ADP é office based/presencial, com a possibilidade de trabalho em home-office por até duas vezes na semana

Considerando que as atividades desempenhadas pelos ocupantes deste cargo envolvem acesso a informações altamente confidenciais e sensíveis de clientes da ADP e de seus respectivos empregados, a ADP reserva-se o direito de conduzir checagem de histórico, de tempos em tempos, conforme autoriza o Incidente de Recurso de Revista Repetitivo nº 01 do Tribunal Superior do Trabalho, mediante consentimento do candidato/trabalhador.”

title: System Engineer Sr/IT-OT Integration
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for System Engineer Sr/IT-OT Integration .


In this role you will:

Install, commission, and integrate IT–OT environments in life sciences manufacturing. Blend hands-on industrial automation with secure networking, clear documentation, and cross functional collaboration.

  • Install, commission, and support IT-OT and related IT application solutions in production.
  • Develop and maintain UNIX shell and Windows scripts for automation and operations.
  • Configure secure industrial networks and OT→IT data flows; ensure reliability and compliance.
  • Connect platforms (Ignition, HiveMQ; HighByte advantageous) using OPC UA, MQTT, BACnet, Modbus.
  • Design system architectures; produce clear installation/integration diagrams and runbooks.
  • Collaborate in agile teams; engage confidently with technical and business stakeholders.
  • Databases: Install, design and query across SQL and NoSQL stores; support historian connectivity.


We have some requirements:

  • Bachelors in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field; or equivalent practical experience.
  • Familiarity with enterprise architecture Documentation tools.
  • Strong analytical/problem solving and methodical troubleshooting.

title: Analista de negócios sênior (ArcGIS)
description:
Estamos procurando um profissional com capacidade de realizar a análise de negócios, na área de Recursos Nauturais, orientando a equipe no desenvolvimento e/ou manutenção de soluções de GIS/TI nas fases de Design, Construção, Tecnologia, Requisitos, Teste, Infraestrutura, Configuração e Qualidade.


Formação:

  • Superior completo em Ciências Exatas, da Terra e afins.


Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Conhecimento do sistema ArcGIS;
  • Conhecimento de SIG;
  • Conhecimento em TI/infraestrutura;
  • Capacidade de análise crítica de especificações de sistemas e negócios;
  • Capacidade de aferir a qualidade da entrega através de testes.


Habilidades Desejáveis:

  • Conceito de Sensoriamento Remoto
  • Conhecimento na área de Recursos Naturais (preferencialmente mineração e/ou meio ambiente);
  • Capacidade de elaborar Plano de Teste e Caderno/Procedimento de Testes;
  • Conhecimento de DevOps;
  • Certificações;
  • Especializações/Mestrado;
  • Inglês Avançado.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Interpretar documentação e informações de negócio compreendendo processos de negócio mapeados e contribuindo para a definição da arquitetura e implementação da solução e ao atendimento das necessidades de negócio existentes.
  • Criar documentação de usuário e administração de sistemas desenvolvidos garantindo o registro do processo e práticas utilizadas.
  • Conduzir processos de Discovery
  • Realizar o levantamento dos requisitos da aplicação
  • Orientar a análise, modelagem e documentação de requisitos funcionais e não funcionais.
  • Disseminar o entendimento sobre os processos de negócio necessários à implementação da solução, assimilando e orientando o uso de conceitos e vocabulário próprio das áreas de negócio envolvidas no projeto.
  • Capacidade de análise crítica de especificações de sistemas e negócios.
  • Capacidade de aferir a qualidade da entrega através de testes.
  • Capacidade de elaborar Plano de Teste e Caderno/Procedimento de Testes de alta complexidade.
  • Avaliar e selecionar as opções da plataforma ESRI que melhor atendam uma respectiva solução.


Por que escolher a Geosistemas?


Saúde e Bem-Estar:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico - Sul América.
  • ✅ Seguro de Vida e Acidentes Pessoais.
  • ️ ♂️ Acesso ao Gympass para cuidar do corpo e da mente.

title: Independent M&A Partner
description:
Junte-se à Elite Global: Escale sua Prática de M&A no Coração Econômico da América Latina


Eleve sua assessoria ao aderir à rede de M&A internacional mais prestigiada do mundo.


O ONEtoONE Corporate Finance Group convida Partners de M&A, MDs e boutiques financeiras baseadas em São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro e nos hubs do Agronegócio a integrarem nossa rede de alto desempenho. Esta é uma oportunidade estratégica de parceria para profissionais independentes que desejam alavancar uma marca global e uma infraestrutura de banco de investimento de classe mundial.


Por que os Partners no Brasil estão escolhendo a ONEtoONE em 2026


O mercado brasileiro em 2026 exige sofisticação. Com a consolidação de setores como Saúde, Logística e Clean Energy , as empresas de médio porte (Middle Market) brasileiras tornaram-se alvos primordiais para o capital estrangeiro.

title: Engenheiros de Dados
description:
Job Description

A Genesis Consulting tem oportunidade para Engenheiros de Dados experientes com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e entrega de valor através da tecnologia. Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades.

Duties and Responsibilities:

• Liderar a implantação de Data Lakes e Lakehouses, atuando tanto no desenho da arquitetura quanto no desenvolvimento hands-on da solução.

• Projetar, desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados eficientes e escaláveis para garantir a fluidez entre sistemas.

• Garantir a integridade, qualidade e governança dos dados em todas as etapas do pipeline.

• Otimizar processos de armazenamento e recuperação de dados, garantindo desempenho e custo eficientes (FINOPS).

• Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com times de negócio e tecnologia para transformar requisitos em soluções robustas de dados.

• Implementar e monitorar processos ETL/ELT e arquiteturas de processamento de dados em tempo real e batch.

• Apoiar a adoção de boas práticas de engenharia de dados dentro do time.

Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

• Experiência comprovada em design e desenvolvimento de pipelines de dados escaláveis (preferencialmente em Oracle Cloud).

• Proficiência em SQL, Python e ferramentas de processamento de dados distribuídos (como Spark).

• Conhecimento avançado em Infrastructure as Code e práticas de CI/CD.

• Experiência com modelagem de dados e arquitetura de Data Lakes e Lakehouses.

• Forte entendimento de práticas de governança e qualidade de dados.

Minimum Education:

  • Ensino superior completo.
  • Inglês fluente

title: Senior DevOps Engineer / Architect
description:
Senior DevOps Engineer / Architect


Location: Remote (Brazil)



About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted technology partner is scaling a modern cloud platform and is seeking a Senior DevOps Engineer / Architect to lead infrastructure strategy and DevOps practices. As the platform continues to grow, this role will be instrumental in building scalable cloud infrastructure, strengthening CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring the platform remains secure, reliable, and cost-efficient.


Position Overview


We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer or Architect who will take ownership of infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud operations. You will play a critical role in ensuring the platform is scalable, secure, and reliable while optimizing performance and cloud cost efficiency.

This position requires a hands-on technical leader who can collaborate closely with engineering, security, and product teams while mentoring developers on DevOps culture and tooling.



What You'll Do:


  • Design, build, and maintain infrastructure using Terraform , ensuring reproducible and version-controlled environments.
  • Own and manage Azure cloud infrastructure including networking, compute, storage, identity, and platform services.
  • Architect and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions for applications built with .NET, PHP, Node.js, React, and Next.js.
  • Implement best practices in pipeline automation, testing integration, artifact management, and deployment workflows .
  • Strengthen platform security by implementing IAM best practices, secrets management, network segmentation, and encryption strategies .
  • Integrate security scanning tools (SAST/DAST/SCA) and compliance checks into infrastructure and deployment pipelines.
  • Build and maintain observability using DataDog and SolarWinds , including monitoring, logging, dashboards, and alerts.
  • Define reliability standards including SLOs, SLIs, and incident response runbooks .
  • Optimize cloud infrastructure costs through resource tagging, autoscaling strategies, reserved capacity planning, and cost monitoring dashboards .
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to promote DevOps culture, automation, and self-service capabilities .



What You Bring:


  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure .
  • Deep expertise with Terraform and infrastructure-as-code practices .
  • Proven experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions .
  • Strong understanding of cloud security practices , including IAM, secrets management, and vulnerability scanning.
  • Experience with Cloudflare services such as CDN, WAF, DNS, and Zero Trust.
  • Strong Linux administration and scripting experience (Bash, Python, or PowerShell ).
  • Experience working with SQL Server in cloud environments .
  • Hands-on experience with monitoring and observability tools such as DataDog or SolarWinds .
  • Strong communication and documentation skills.



Nice to Have

  • Experience with AWS infrastructure such as EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, EKS, or Lambda.
  • Experience with Databricks or modern data platform infrastructure .
  • Familiarity with policy-as-code frameworks such as OPA, Sentinel, or Azure Policy.
  • Experience working with Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, or container security practices .
  • Knowledge of FinOps practices and cloud cost optimization strategies .
  • Experience implementing SRE methodologies such as SLOs and error budgets .



What We Offer:

  • Competitive compensation package aligned with senior-level expertise.
  • Fully remote work environment with flexible collaboration across global teams.
  • The opportunity to shape and lead the DevOps architecture of a growing cloud platform.
  • Work with modern cloud technologies and engineering best practices .
  • A collaborative, engineering-focused culture with high ownership and impact .
  • Opportunities for professional development, certifications, and technical growth .

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
This is mostly manual position. This role is fully remote and is a PJ contractor.


Required Skills & Experience


• 7+ years of experience in Quality Assurance (manual and/or blended QA roles) with strong ownership of test execution and release readiness.

• Jira proficiency for defect tracking, workflows, and reporting.

• Hands-on experience with API testing (e.g., Postman, Swagger, curl, or similar) — note: API work is a smaller portion (~10%).

• Cruise / travel / hotel / hospitality industry experience

• Strong understanding of QA fundamentals: test design, defect lifecycle, SDLC/STLC, and Agile testing practices. Excellent communication skills and ability to partner cross-functionally.


Nice to Have Skills & Experience


• Experience testing eCommerce, booking engines, reservations, loyalty, payments, check-in/boarding, or guest service platforms.

• Exposure to test automation (any framework/tool) and ability to collaborate with automation engineers (if applicable).

• Basic SQL for validation, data checks, or troubleshooting. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and release processes.


Job Description


We are seeking a Senior QA Engineer to help ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of customer-facing and internal applications in a fast-paced travel/hospitality environment. This role will partner closely with product, engineering, and delivery teams to define test strategy, execute testing across releases, and continuously improve QA processes. The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on QA experience, deep familiarity with Jira, and working knowledge of API testing (a smaller portion of the overall workload).


Day to Day

• Own and execute end-to-end testing for web and/or mobile applications, including functional, regression, smoke, and UAT support.

• Create and maintain clear test plans, test cases, and test execution evidence aligned to release timelines.

• Work in Agile/Scrum teams to provide early QA input on requirements, acceptance criteria, and edge cases.

• Log, track, and manage defects in Jira, ensuring high-quality documentation and strong follow-through through resolution.

• Perform API validation/testing (estimated ~10% of overall effort) using tools such as Postman/Swagger or similar; validate request/response payloads and integration behaviors.

• Collaborate with engineers and product owners to reproduce issues, validate fixes, and confirm release readiness.

• Help improve QA efficiency through better test coverage, risk-based testing, and repeatable regression approaches. Contribute to quality standards, best practices, and continuous improvement across the SDLC.

description:

O que você vai fazer:

  • Liderar e orientar equipes de desenvolvedores, interagindo com múltiplas Squads para garantir o sucesso dos produtos/projetos;

  • Garantir a qualidade do código e dos produtos;
  • Avaliar e otimizar o desempenho dos aplicativos e sistemas;

  • Apoiar infra na gestão de custo da AWS;
  • Contribuir para planejamento de solução junto ao time de produto e design.

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento de software com Nodejs;
  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento de aplicações em nuvem ambiente AWS;
  • Conhecimento em mensageria Kafka, RabbitMQ, Etc;
  • Experiência em git e gitflow;
  • Experiência em liderança de equipes;
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de software em escala e Micro serviços;

  • Assistência médica
  • Assistência odontológica
  • Alura

  • Total Pass

title: UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer
description:
UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer


About the Role

We are looking for a UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer to help improve the performance of a large-scale digital commerce platform. This role focuses on identifying friction in critical customer journeys and delivering usability improvements that directly impact conversion.


You will own the Usability workstream, partnering closely with product and analytics teams to analyze user behavior, uncover drop-off points, and design improvements across key transactional flows such as cart, checkout, and payment.


This role is ideal for a designer who combines strong UX thinking with analytical rigor and enjoys working in fast-moving consulting environments where rapid insights and quick wins are highly valued.


What You’ll Do

  • Lead usability analysis across critical customer journeys including product discovery, cart, checkout, and payment.
  • Conduct funnel analysis to identify friction points and conversion drop-offs throughout the purchase process.
  • Partner with product and analytics teams to analyze quantitative data such as conversion rates, abandonment points, and user behavior patterns.
  • Map end-to-end customer journeys to identify quick wins and usability improvements that can drive immediate conversion gains.
  • Design and prototype improvements to transactional flows, focusing on reducing friction and simplifying the purchasing experience.
  • Present insights and design recommendations to stakeholders, clearly tying usability improvements to measurable business impact.
  • Work within a fast-paced consulting team delivering iterative improvements across short delivery cycles.


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in UX design or product design
  • Strong experience with data-driven design approaches, including funnel analysis and conversion optimization
  • Ability to collaborate with product and analytics teams to interpret quantitative data and translate insights into UX improvements
  • Experience mapping end-to-end user journeys and identifying usability improvements
  • Proven experience redesigning transactional flows such as cart, checkout, or payment experiences
  • Strong problem-solving and research skills
  • Fluency in Portuguese (required working language)
  • Comfort working in fast-paced consulting environments with tight delivery timelines


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with A/B testing frameworks and experimentation programs
  • Background designing for marketplace platforms or high-traffic e-commerce products

title: Programa Jovem Aprendiz 2026
description:
Por que trabalhar conosco?


O Butantan é o maior produtor de vacinas e soros da América Latina e o principal fabricante de imunizantes contra a gripe (influenza) do hemisfério Sul. Referência mundial de eficiência e qualidade, também é responsável por grande parte da produção de soros hiperimunes e vacinas oferecidos à população gratuitamente pelo Programa Nacional de Imunizações (PNI), como as vacinas contra hepatite A, hepatite B, HPV, raiva e DTPA.

Aqui no Butantan, valorizamos a diversidade.

Promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, que se traduz no respeito à diversidade de gênero, etnia, pessoa com deficiência, orientação sexual (LGBTQIAPN+), crenças e religiões. Buscamos pessoas alinhadas aos nossos valores e que queiram crescer e se desenvolver junto com a instituição.


Buscamos um(a) profissional que atuará: Jovem Aprendiz (Administrativo/Produção):

  • Auxiliar nas rotinas dos Departamentos;
  • Realizar atendimento, acompanhamento de relatórios, input de dados em sistema;
  • Atender outras atividades profissionais correlatas e inerentes ao programa.


Quais são os requisitos imprescindíveis para essa vaga?

  • Ensino médio cursando ou completo
  • Conhecimento do Pacote Office
  • Ter entre 18 e 22 anos


Nosso pacote de benefícios:

  • Vale transporte;
  • Refeitório no local (para os dias presenciais no Complexo Butantan);
  • Vale Refeição (para os dias de treinamento externo);
  • Ônibus fretado - Instituto Butantan/ Metrô/Instituto Butantan;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Descontos em parcerias de entretenimentos;
  • Ingressos para os museus do Butantan;
  • Totalpass – benefício focado na saúde e bem estar dos colaboradores;
  • Avaliação de desempenho e auto avaliação;
  • Participação em palestras e Workshops realizados no Butantan;
  • Mentoria;
  • Day Off de aniversário – O (a) Aprendiz terá direito a uma folga no mês do aniversário, acordado com a gestão.


Informações complementares:

Período de inscrições: 16/03/2026 a 30/03/2026

Quantidade de vaga(s): 60

Local de Trabalho: São Paulo - Brasil

Horário de trabalho: 08h às 14h15 ou 12h às 18h15

Modelo de trabalho: Presencial


O processo seletivo será composto pelas seguintes etapas:

  • Análise curricular e triagem de candidatos;
  • Entrevista com recrutadores;
  • Entrevista individual com o requisitante;
  • Entrevista individual com o gestor do requisitante.


Todas as etapas são eliminatórias e podemos indicar uma ou mais etapas a informar no processo seletivo.


*Validade do processo seletivo: 06 meses

title: Search Engine Optimization Manager
description:
About us:

At Near, we help top talent in Latin America find remote roles with US companies. Our mission is to create better lives by fostering a remote work culture that transcends borders.


Overview:

One of our fast-growing US clients is looking for a versatile SEO marketer with a strong Growth foundation and proven experience running B2B campaigns. In this role, you'll own the search strategy, drive measurable pipeline growth, and support high-impact marketing initiatives across the funnel.


You’ll spend about 60% of your time on SEO (including AI-driven SEO) and 40% on broader growth projects . From improving rankings on Google and LLMs to launching targeted ads on LinkedIn and Google, you’ll be responsible for identifying the biggest opportunities, creating a plan, and executing quickly.


This is a high-agency, high-impact role for someone who thrives in fast-moving environments and wants room to grow.


Responsibilities:

  • Own and evolve the SEO strategy to improve rankings, visibility, and conversions across both Google search and large language models.
  • Conduct keyword research, optimize on-page content, lead technical SEO improvements, and run AI-SEO experiments.
  • Report weekly on performance, key insights, and recommended actions.
  • Launch, manage, and optimize B2B campaigns on LinkedIn Ads and Google Ads to drive qualified leads.
  • Write high-converting copy for ads, landing pages, and growth experiments.
  • Support awareness and demand-gen initiatives, including webinar promotion, content refreshes, and campaign execution.
  • Collaborate closely with the Sr. Growth Marketing Manager to execute cross-functional growth projects.


Skills & Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of marketing experience, including 3+ years in B2B environments.
  • Proven success in SEO, including technical SEO, content optimization, and AI-driven SEO strategies.
  • Hands-on experience managing and optimizing campaigns on LinkedIn Ads and Google Ads .
  • Proficiency with SEO tools such as SEMrush , Ahrefs , or equivalents.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Strong copywriting ability, especially for ads and landing pages.
  • High ownership mindset, you prioritize effectively, execute independently, and move fast.


Nice-to-Haves:

  • Startup experience or comfort operating in fast-paced environments.
  • Experience with conversion rate optimization (CRO) and landing page optimization.

You’ll spend about 60% of your time on SEO (including AI-driven SEO) and 40% on broader growth projects . From improving rankings on Google and LLMs to launching targeted ads on LinkedIn and Google, you’ll be responsible for identifying the biggest opportunities, creating a plan, and executing quickly.


This is a high-agency, high-impact role for someone who thrives in fast-moving environments and wants room to grow.


Responsibilities:

  • Own and evolve the SEO strategy to improve rankings, visibility, and conversions across both Google search and large language models.
  • Conduct keyword research, optimize on-page content, lead technical SEO improvements, and run AI-SEO experiments.
  • Report weekly on performance, key insights, and recommended actions.
  • Launch, manage, and optimize B2B campaigns on LinkedIn Ads and Google Ads to drive qualified leads.
  • Write high-converting copy for ads, landing pages, and growth experiments.
  • Support awareness and demand-gen initiatives, including webinar promotion, content refreshes, and campaign execution.
  • Collaborate closely with the Sr. Growth Marketing Manager to execute cross-functional growth projects.


Skills & Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of marketing experience, including 3+ years in B2B environments.
  • Proven success in SEO, including technical SEO, content optimization, and AI-driven SEO strategies.
  • Hands-on experience managing and optimizing campaigns on LinkedIn Ads and Google Ads .
  • Proficiency with SEO tools such as SEMrush , Ahrefs , or equivalents.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Strong copywriting ability, especially for ads and landing pages.
  • High ownership mindset, you prioritize effectively, execute independently, and move fast.


Nice-to-Haves:

  • Startup experience or comfort operating in fast-paced environments.
  • Experience with conversion rate optimization (CRO) and landing page optimization.

title: Senior Applied Scientist – Computer Vision & Machine Learning
description:
Senior Applied Scientist – Computer Vision & Machine Learning

Location: Brazil (remote)

Contract: PJ (long-term)

We’re looking for a Senior Applied Scientist to join our Inbound team and build highly scalable machine learning solutions that power item attribute detection (e.g., color, material, style) and merchandise authenticity verification.

If you’re passionate about solving real-world business problems using state-of-the-art Computer Vision and ML techniques — and enjoy taking ownership from research to production — we’d love to connect.


What You’ll Do

  • Develop and deploy Computer Vision and Machine Learning solutions to solve high-impact business challenges
  • Design, build, and maintain clean, efficient, and scalable production-grade code
  • Analyze large-scale datasets to extract insights and drive data-informed decisions
  • Apply state-of-the-art ML methodologies (CNNs, Transformers, GANs, etc.) to build robust models
  • Lead the technical direction of key components and systems
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and Tech Leads to deliver deployable solutions
  • Mentor team members and help grow domain expertise
  • Contribute to technical leadership through patents and publications


Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of industry experience in Computer Vision and Applied Machine Learning
  • Master’s or PhD in CS, ML, Statistics, or related field (or 8+ years of industry experience)
  • 3+ years building, deploying, and managing ML/DL models in production at scale
  • Deep understanding of ML/CV techniques: CNNs, Transformers, GANs, optimizers, regularization
  • Strong experience with experiment design, A/B testing, training/serving pipelines, and feature engineering
  • Proficiency in Python and scientific libraries (NumPy, Pandas)
  • Hands-on experience with ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, Scikit-learn)
  • Strong data engineering skills with large-scale datasets
  • Experience with experiment automation tools (Ray Tune, Weights & Biases, Kubeflow)
  • Cloud experience (AWS, GCP, or Azure)


Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD in CS, ML, AI, Statistics, OR, or related field
  • Experience applying ML to real-world retail problems
  • Familiarity with MLOps pipelines and tools
  • Strong ownership mindset with a focus on measurable business impact

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Mainframe SR
description:
Estamos em busca de uma pessoa profissional em desenvolvimento Mainframe, para atuar no desenvolvimento e manutenção de aplicações bancárias em ambiente IBM z/OS, utilizando COBOL, CICS, JCL, VSAM e DB2, com foco em estabilidade, segurança e performance.


Principais atividades:

  • Analisar, desenvolver e manter programas COBOL para processos batch e online.
  • Construir e sustentar transações CICS, incluindo telas BMS e integrações internas.
  • Escrever, otimizar e executar JCL para jobs batch, tratando abends e dependências.
  • Modelar, consultar e otimizar dados em VSAM e DB2 (SQL, índices, reorganizações).
  • Investigar e corrigir incidentes; apoiar testes (unitários, integrados, UAT) e promover entregas com conformidade bancária.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência em ambiente de sistema bancário com COBOL, CICS, JCL, VSAM e DB2.
  • Domínio de processamento batch/online, controle de concorrência, transações e recuperação.
  • Vivência em tuning e troubleshooting: leitura de dumps e logs, performance de jobs e SQL.
  • Capacidade de levantar requisitos, estimar, desenhar soluções e documentar.
  • Atenção a normas de segurança, qualidade e compliance do setor financeiro.


Informações adicionais:

  • Contratação CLT
  • Atuação remota

title: Support Specialist
description:
At Drip, we believe the world needs independent retail. Thousands of ecommerce brands all over the globe trust Drip to build engaging and profitable relationships with their customers. Our Nurture Marketing Platform has generated more than $1 billion in revenue for our customers since 2018. We do this by unleashing the power of direct-to-consumer brands’ customer data to deliver perfectly personalized email and SMS marketing strategies that are proven to grow their revenue. And we’re just getting started! We are well-funded, growing super fast, and building a beautiful product with crew members located around the US and in our Minneapolis Hub. 


Working at Drip means empowering the ecommerce rebellion alongside some of the best people in the biz. We've worked hard to build an awesome company culture based on our 5 Guiding Principles that are more than just words on a wall (learn more: Ready to empower the rebellion? Join Drip!



About the opportunity

As a Support Specialist at Drip, you’ll be part of our small, nimble team providing technical guidance and unparalleled support for our customers. Our world-first product is in the hands of global merchants, and our team is a critical piece in ensuring their success during usage. The specialist acts as the first point of contact for clients or users facing technical challenges and is expected to provide clear communication and effective solutions. The working hours for this position are 9:00am - 5:30pm US Central Time M-F.

﻿This is a full-time contractor engagement (PJ). You will be a fully integrated member of our global crew. 




We’re engaging and collaborative as we resolve questions and help create customer-facing self-help resources. How do we do that?



Key Responsibilities:
  • Troubleshooting & Problem Solving
  • Diagnose and resolve software and network-related issues.
  • Assist users in resolving technical problems with applications, computer systems, and network devices.
  • Identify root causes of issues and recommend solutions or escalate to higher-level support as needed.
  • Customer Support
  • Provide timely and effective customer service via email, chat, or video.
  • Guide customers through problem-solving steps, explaining technical details in an understandable manner.
  • Document customer issues and solutions in a ticketing system.
  • Documentation & Reporting
  • Create and update technical documentation, user guides, and FAQs.
  • Report recurring technical issues to management or product development teams to address underlying problems.
  • Maintain detailed records of customer interactions, resolutions, and troubleshooting processes.
  • Escalation Management
  • Work with the Escalations Team to escalate complex issues when first-line troubleshooting does not resolve the problem.
  • Collaborate with other departments (Product, Engineering, Success) to ensure comprehensive issue resolution.

    • Skills & Qualifications:
    • Technical Expertise:
    • Proficiency in operating systems (Windows, macOS, Linux) and common software applications.
    • Strong understanding of network configurations, protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP), and hardware components.
    • Familiarity with ticketing systems and remote troubleshooting tools.
    • Technically inclined with the ability to understand and work with APIs, integrations, and data flows between systems.
    • Comfortable reading and interpreting light code (e.g., JSON, HTML, basic scripting) to diagnose issues, troubleshoot integrations, and collaborate effectively with engineering teams.
    • Curious and adaptable, with a desire to learn new tools, technologies, and platforms quickly.
    • Problem-solving Ability:
    • An analytical mindset with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues quickly.
    • Capable of working under pressure and handling multiple tasks simultaneously.
    • Communication Skills:
    • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, able to explain technical issues to non-technical users.
    • Strong customer service skills with a focus on user satisfaction.
    • Organizational Skills:
    • Detail-oriented, with strong documentation and record-keeping abilities.
    • Ability to prioritize tasks and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment.



    Preferred Experience:
    • Previous experience in a help desk, IT support, or technical support role.
    • Knowledge of cloud-based services (e.g., AWS, Azure) and virtualization technologies.
    • Experience with troubleshooting mobile devices (Android, iOS).
    • Familiarity with APIs, integrations, or automation concepts (hands-on experience a plus, but not required).
    • Comfort reviewing technical documentation or light code to support troubleshooting and collaboration with engineering teams.
    • Previous work with an American company
    Education & Certifications:
    • Formal education in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline is preferred but not required.
    • Equivalent experience gained through professional work, certifications, technical training programs, or self-study is highly valued.
    • Continuous learning mindset, with interest in understanding APIs, integrations, and modern SaaS platforms.


    Who You Are:

    • A solid technical aptitude - we love tech support backgrounds or a history of self-started technical growth.
    • You’re an empathetic self-starter who loves technology and enjoys helping others to successfully use it - this isn’t run-of-the-mill customer service, we strive for the Melt Your Face experience! We represent the human side of Drip
    • Passion for helping others internally and externally 
    • Impeccable written and verbal communication and strong attention to detail
    • In addition, we give bonus points for having a SaaS or Ecommerce background!

title: Support Specialist
description:
At Drip, we believe the world needs independent retail. Thousands of ecommerce brands all over the globe trust Drip to build engaging and profitable relationships with their customers. Our Nurture Marketing Platform has generated more than $1 billion in revenue for our customers since 2018. We do this by unleashing the power of direct-to-consumer brands’ customer data to deliver perfectly personalized email and SMS marketing strategies that are proven to grow their revenue. And we’re just getting started! We are well-funded, growing super fast, and building a beautiful product with crew members located around the US and in our Minneapolis Hub. 


Working at Drip means empowering the ecommerce rebellion alongside some of the best people in the biz. We've worked hard to build an awesome company culture based on our 5 Guiding Principles that are more than just words on a wall (learn more: Ready to empower the rebellion? Join Drip!



About the opportunity

As a Support Specialist at Drip, you’ll be part of our small, nimble team providing technical guidance and unparalleled support for our customers. Our world-first product is in the hands of global merchants, and our team is a critical piece in ensuring their success during usage. The specialist acts as the first point of contact for clients or users facing technical challenges and is expected to provide clear communication and effective solutions. The working hours for this position are 9:00am - 5:30pm US Central Time M-F.

﻿This is a full-time contractor engagement (PJ). You will be a fully integrated member of our global crew. 




We’re engaging and collaborative as we resolve questions and help create customer-facing self-help resources. How do we do that?



Key Responsibilities:
  • Troubleshooting & Problem Solving
  • Diagnose and resolve software and network-related issues.
  • Assist users in resolving technical problems with applications, computer systems, and network devices.
  • Identify root causes of issues and recommend solutions or escalate to higher-level support as needed.
  • Customer Support
  • Provide timely and effective customer service via email, chat, or video.
  • Guide customers through problem-solving steps, explaining technical details in an understandable manner.
  • Document customer issues and solutions in a ticketing system.
  • Documentation & Reporting
  • Create and update technical documentation, user guides, and FAQs.
  • Report recurring technical issues to management or product development teams to address underlying problems.
  • Maintain detailed records of customer interactions, resolutions, and troubleshooting processes.
  • Escalation Management
  • Work with the Escalations Team to escalate complex issues when first-line troubleshooting does not resolve the problem.
  • Collaborate with other departments (Product, Engineering, Success) to ensure comprehensive issue resolution.

    • Proficiency in operating systems (Windows, macOS, Linux) and common software applications.
    • Strong understanding of network configurations, protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP), and hardware components.
    • Familiarity with ticketing systems and remote troubleshooting tools.
    • Technically inclined with the ability to understand and work with APIs, integrations, and data flows between systems.
    • Comfortable reading and interpreting light code (e.g., JSON, HTML, basic scripting) to diagnose issues, troubleshoot integrations, and collaborate effectively with engineering teams.

    • An analytical mindset with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues quickly.
    • Capable of working under pressure and handling multiple tasks simultaneously.

    • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, able to explain technical issues to non-technical users.
    • Strong customer service skills with a focus on user satisfaction.

    • Detail-oriented, with strong documentation and record-keeping abilities.
    • Ability to prioritize tasks and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment.



    Preferred Experience:
    • Previous experience in a help desk, IT support, or technical support role.
    • Knowledge of cloud-based services (e.g., AWS, Azure) and virtualization technologies.
    • Experience with troubleshooting mobile devices (Android, iOS).
    • Familiarity with APIs, integrations, or automation concepts (hands-on experience a plus, but not required).
    • Comfort reviewing technical documentation or light code to support troubleshooting and collaboration with engineering teams.
    • Previous work with an American company
    Education & Certifications:
    • Formal education in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline is preferred but not required.
    • Equivalent experience gained through professional work, certifications, technical training programs, or self-study is highly valued.
    • Continuous learning mindset, with interest in understanding APIs, integrations, and modern SaaS platforms.

    • Passion for helping others internally and externally 
    • Impeccable written and verbal communication and strong attention to detail
    • In addition, we give bonus points for having a SaaS or Ecommerce background!

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
Uma das pioneiras em soluções de inteligência de dados no Open Finance, a klavi é uma das instituições que mais cresce nesse ecossistema, levando inovação através de dados a milhares de brasileiros. A klavi utiliza tecnologia própria e de ponta para viabilizar a coleta de dados, além de automatizar todo o processamento desses dados para transformá-los em valor de negócio.


Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de QA com foco em garantir a qualidade, confiabilidade e desempenho das soluções desenvolvidas pela Klavi. Essa pessoa atuará de forma colaborativa com os times de produto e engenharia, contribuindo para a definição de cenários de teste, automação de testes, identificação e prevenção de bugs em todas as etapas do desenvolvimento. O objetivo é assegurar que nossas entregas atendam aos mais altos padrões de qualidade, proporcionando uma excelente experiência para os usuários finais.


Cultura da klavi

  • Busca constante pela excelência: Somos automotivados, nunca satisfeitos e sempre buscando melhorias. Cada pessoa deve ser um especialista na empresa e em seu segmento. Nós elevamos continuamente o nível para fornecer produtos, serviços e processos de alta qualidade.
  • Inovar para revolucionar: Encorajamos as pessoas a serem curiosas e a desafiarem o status quo. Ouvimos sempre novas ideias e estamos abertos a perguntas. Não temos medo de mudanças.
  • Construção e valorização coletiva: Colabore com seus colegas e celebrem juntos as vitórias. Sejam transparentes, respeitosos e confiem uns nos outros. Nós não reclamamos, mas encontramos soluções juntos.
  • Foco no sucesso do cliente: Nosso sucesso está enraizado no sucesso dos nossos clientes. Sempre nos esforçamos para superar suas expectativas. Buscamos fornecer as melhores soluções e valores a longo prazo.


Salário

  • Regime: PJ
  • Salário: Competitivo
  • Nível: Especialista


Principais responsabilidades

  • Investigar e diagnosticar falhas, identificando a causa raiz de bugs e inconsistências no sistema.
  • Criar suítes de testes com base nos requisitos funcionais e não funcionais das features.
  • Implementar testes automatizados para garantir a cobertura e a confiabilidade de novas funcionalidades.
  • Validar o estado do sistema antes de implantações, garantindo que todos os ambientes estejam estáveis e prontos para release.
  • Ter um entendimento profundo dos fluxos atuais do sistema para antecipar riscos e propor melhorias de qualidade.
  • Monitorar continuamente a saúde e o desempenho das aplicações, atuando preventivamente em casos de instabilidade.

Requisitos necessários:

  • Inglês avançado – Será necessário para se comunicar com times internacionais, participar de reuniões técnicas e colaborar em projetos globais.
  • Formação acadêmica na área de computação – Graduação completa ou em andamento em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência com os testes automatizados
  • Disponibilidade para trabalho presencial – Atuação no escritório da Klavi em São Paulo, em modelo híbrido ou presencial, conforme combinado.
  • Tech Stack: Python, Java, Golang, AWS (EKS, SQS, SNS), PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Redis, Git, Jenkins, Grafana


Nossos benefícios:

  • Plano de saúde, Plano Odontológico e Seguro de Vida;
  • Flash benefícios: Vale Refeição, Alimentação e Auxílio Home Office;
  • Licença Parental estendida: a licença maternidade é de 6 meses e a licença parental é de 30 dias;
  • Auxílio Creche;
  • Incentivo a educação;
  • Gympass;
  • Day Off aniversário;
  • Chat GPT Pro;
  • Bônus.

title: Arquiteto Sênior SAP Basis e Infraestrutura
description:
Sobre a Empresa



Você atuará como referência técnica em projetos estratégicos e ambientes de alta complexidade. Será responsável por impulsionar a evolução técnica do time, fortalecer o framework de conhecimento e certificações, além de apoiar iniciativas críticas e o time de Suporte (MS).



Sobre o Papel



Procuramos um(a) profissional com visão de arquitetura, mentalidade de aprendizado contínuo e forte interesse em tecnologias emergentes como SAP BTP, IA, SAP Activate e integrações com Azure, AWS e GCP.



Responsabilidades



  • Liderar iniciativas técnicas SAP Basis, incluindo migrações (S/4HANA, ECC, PI/PO, etc), upgrades e projetos críticos em ambientes Cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP).
  • Conduzir assessments técnicos e de performance (tunning, banco de dados, arquitetura, etc) e definir recomendações de otimização.
  • Atuar como referência técnica e ponto de escalonamento, oferecendo suporte Nível 3 e 4, inclusive em situações de crise (war rooms) em ambientes complexos.
  • Desenvolver e manter arquitetura SAP, garantindo escalabilidade, segurança, alta disponibilidade e aderência às melhores práticas da SAP e dos hyperscalers.
  • Apoiar os times de suporte (Managed Services) e Projetos (Professional Services), incluindo manutenção, melhorias, auditorias, mudanças, atualizações e rotinas operacionais em SAP ECC, S/4 e RISE.
  • Colaborar com stakeholders internos/externos, garantindo alinhamento estratégico, qualidade das entregas e orientação técnica ao time Basis.
