title: Revenue Operations Associate
description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.


What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals.

From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention

If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.


About SpendHound:

  • SpendHound is a 100% free software renewal management platform and service recently launched by the research firm YipitData. (See this introductory video from SpendHound’s Senior Product Manager!)
  • SpendHound is the single source of truth for companies’ renewal information and includes:
  • A comprehensive view of all software applications used with annual contract values, auto-renewal information, renewal dates, license counts, and more
  • An invoice and contract management system for companies to store their invoices and contracts
  • Renewal reminders through email and Slack so companies never miss upcoming software renewals
  • Free advice from procurement experts to discuss price benchmarking insights and negotiation strategies for any upcoming renewals
  • Companies use the SpendHound platform and procurement expert service to save time and money on their software renewals.
  • SpendHound is free for customers because customer data is de-identified, aggregated with other panelists, and used as part of YipitData market research (example report ).


About The Role:

Are you a collaborative consulting, analytics, or operations professional with 3+ years of experience, passionate about building a world-class revenue team?

We are seeking a Revenue Operations Associate to play a crucial role in our fast-growing team, SpendHound. As a fast-growing “start-up” within a larger organization, this is a unique opportunity for someone with a strong operational mindset to come in and help build something truly special.


We expect East work hours.


As our Revenue Operations Associate, you will partner with our Sales and Marketing teams to:

  • Be an operations subject matter expert for the Sales function, working closely with RevOps and Spendhound leadership to support Sales and execute on key initiatives
  • Implement processes and solutions that can streamline revenue acquisition and eliminate inefficiencies
  • Maintain and measure various components of the Sales process, such as
  • Target/Territory Management
  • Lead Generation, and
  • Outbound Cadence Operations.
  • Ensure that the Sales teams are operating seamlessly through data evaluation and by improving workflows


You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • Operations professional with 3+ years of experience, passionate about building a world-class revenue team.
  • You demonstrate a high aptitude for organization, process development, project and change management, and analytics
  • You have advanced Excel skills
  • Your experience with CRMs such as Salesforce.com
  • You are willing to become proficient in SQL and data management
  • You are a natural problem-solver, with a keen eye for detail and spotting issues
  • You have advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)
  • You are committed to continuously improving yourself and helping those around you


What We Offer:

  • Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits)
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package
  • Remote work
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. See more on our high-impact, high-opportunity work environment above!



Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Climate and Energy Study (Paid Consultancy Opportunity)
description:
Company - RONIN International is an independent B2B market research company specialising in business, healthcare and tech studies. We are part of the Rippleffect Group (formerly Fat Media Group) and are Company Partners of The Market Research Society (MRS), Corporate Members of ESOMAR, Members of the Insights Association and Council Members of The Interviewer Quality Control Scheme (IQCS).



About - We are looking to speak with Gen Z who are interested in participating in market research on Climate and Energy topics. The market research will be conducted in pair with your friend.



Qualifications:

  • Able to talk about the climate and the energy sector or have no deeper understanding on the Energy system
  • The paid consultancy session will be conducted as an informal 60-minute interview conducted via MS Teams
  • Please note that you will be conducting the interview session with as a pair with your friend.


Compensation package - BRL 530 for a 60-minute online Interview per person.

title: Senior Application Security Engineer
description:
Project Description:

  • One of the world's largest providers of products and services to the energy industry has a need to develop, support and integrate software system in Oil & Gas domain.
  • You will be a member of a cross functional team.
  • Key project stakeholders are open for innovative ideas.
  • Project is based on SCRUM methodology.
  • This is a great opportunity to work in an international team, apply and learn modern IT technologies


Responsibilities:

  • Application Security with strong AI/ML security exposure
  • Threat modeling and risk assessment for AI systems, APIs, and cloud-native applications
  • Protection against prompt injection, adversarial ML, data poisoning, and model abuse
  • Secure SDLC and CI/CD integration, including MLOps pipelines
  • Hands-on experience with SAST, DAST, SCA, container scanning, and security automation
  • Strong collaboration with development and data science teams


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • 5+ years in Application Security, with at least 1-2 years focused on AI/ML security
  • Strong secure coding and vulnerability management background (OWASP Top 10)
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS and/or Azure)
  • Strong programming skills in Python or Java
  • Familiarity with AI platforms such as Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, or Spark
  • Strong communication skills


Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

  • Good knowledge of Microsoft Active Directory services
  • Firewall and security group administration practical experience.
  • Good understanding of AICPA SOC2 controls and processes.
  • Thorough knowledge of network security and protocols.
  • Knowledge of cryptography protocols and hands-on experience in SSL certificates generation.
  • Penetration testing hands-on experience in Azure and AWS cloud environments and Kubernetes clusters.
  • Web and desktop applications penetration testing hands-on experience.


Languages:

  • English: B2 Upper Intermediate

title: Consultor JD Edwards (JDE)
description:
Sobre a Empresa

Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.


Sobre o Cargo:

Consultor Funcional de Finanças JD Edwards (JDE) para integrar a área Digital & IT, responsável por desenhar, configurar e implementar soluções no módulo financeiro do JDE

O profissional atuará na transformação do ambiente de ERP, trabalhando em ambiente internacional e multicultural, colaborando com stakeholders e equipes globais para entregar soluções integradas alinhadas às necessidades do negócio.

Atuação abrangente nas etapas de Análise, Design, Codificação, Testes, Depuração e Suporte de aplicações corporativas.

Experiência no desenvolvimento e sustentação de aplicações de negócios complexas , atuando em diferentes áreas funcionais .

Condução de revisões técnicas de design e código , com foco em qualidade, experiência do usuário, desempenho, escalabilidade e evolução contínua das soluções .

Experiência em projetos de rollout e expansão de sistemas , garantindo a implantação estruturada e aderente às necessidades do negócio.

Vivência em ambientes multiculturais , atuando em colaboração com equipes globais e distribuídas .


*Inglês fluente imprescindível

100% Remoto

Contratação CLT obrigatória

SKILL

Requires experience

• Functional experience/ Financial, Sales, Procurement, Distribution)

• Involved in all phases of the Software Development Lifecycle

• Analysis, Design, Coding, Testing, Debugging and Support of business

• Work with complicated business applications across functional areas

• Manage design and code reviews with a focus on the best user experience, performance, scalability and future expansion

• Previous experience in Rollout

• Experience working with global teams


Mandatory Skills

• JD Edwards with Finacne functional experience(Financial, Sales, Procurement, Distribution)

• Well versed with Brazil localization (ex: Tax reform etc)

• Fluent English speaking and writing

• Mapping business processes

• Knows technically the phases of the activities, identifies and guides in solving problems

• JD Edwards Versions E9.2


Recommended Skills

• Meet any needs of the customer service support to clarify doubts and correct BUGs;

• Analyse requests to define functional and how the development will be implemented

• Ability to interact with business users, understand business processes, and engineer solutions to business problems


Soft skills

• Very strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, enhancement, and maintenance skills

• Good communication and interpersonal skills

• Fluent English speaking and writing

• Fluent in Portuguese (local language of Brazil)


Degree

• Degree or higher


CLT - obrigatório

Benefícios:

Vale Refeição - Cartão Swille

title: Customer Success Manager (EMEA)
description:
Location: LATAM

Department: Success Department

Role: Customer Success Manager (EMEA)

Mode: Full-time


About Respond.io

Founded in Hong Kong in early 2017, respond.io is an AI-powered business messaging platform that helps companies manage customer conversations across chat, calls and email — all in one place.


Trusted by businesses in over 127 countries and recognized by G2 and SME100, respond.io enables fast-growing companies around the world to capture, convert, and retain customers at scale.


We operate as a globally distributed team with employees based around the world, contributing to a diverse and inclusive culture. Join us, and be part of a team that is shaping the future of customer conversation management!


Our Culture

At respond.io, we move fast, work smart, and always keep our customers at the heart of what we do. Here’s what we stand for:

  • Solve Customer Problems: Every effort must solve real customer pain points. No guesswork—just real feedback and clear value!
  • The 80/20 Rule: We focus on 20% of actions that create 80% of the value. Simple is powerful—it gets us moving fast.
  • 100% Alignment, 80% Accuracy: We aim 100% team alignment and 80% accuracy. Perfect plans can wait—clear goals come first.
  • Be Direct: We give honest feedback, and tackle problems head-on. Clarity moves us forward!
  • Own It and Support Each Other: We step up, help out, and drive outcomes—together.
  • Build Human Connections: Work is better when we trust, care, and celebrate wins together. We’re a team!


Role Description

At Respond.io, the role of Customer Success Manager is pivotal to our company's success. As a Customer Success Manager, you will be the go-to resource for top-tier customers to ensure successful product adoption and retention. This role entails handling clients onboarding, clients retention, and success planning.


Our ideal candidate will have the experience of working in a B2B SaaS company, and handling a fair share of different business processes. We are seeking someone who can ensure that our clients receive a great experience while working with us.


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate closely with customers to understand their goals and help them maximize the value of the Respond.io platform
  • Assist customers during the onboarding process, ensuring a positive and smooth experience
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with both internal and external stakeholders
  • Act as a point of contact for customer issues and ensure timely resolution
  • Gain a deep understanding of customer needs, use cases, and objectives to ensure effective utilization of the Respond.io platform
  • Monitor and report on customer satisfaction and platform usage
  • Focus on maintaining high customer satisfaction and retention rates
  • Acquire in-depth knowledge of the Respond.io platform and identify opportunities for customer growth, collaborating with the internal team to propose upsells


Qualifications

  • 3+ years of B2B SaaS experience in Customer Success, Consulting, and Account Management
  • Experienced in working with international customers and handling global accounts
  • Attentive listener with an ability to address customer concerns effectively
  • Strong communication skills in Arabic and English to convey complex ideas clearly
  • Skilled in negotiating complex renewal contracts in a SaaS environment
  • Proficient in optimizing complex business processes
  • Familiarity with business messaging platforms, CRM systems, and Customer Success tools
  • Passionate about digital transformation and understanding diverse businesses
  • Ability to provide customer feedback and insights to various departments for product improvement
  • Deep understanding of our products, industry trends, and competition
  • Able to quickly grasp technical concepts and keen to become an expert in our software
  • An agile team player who is excited by the fast-paced start-up environment and is eager to make a difference


Here's what's in for you

  • You will become part of an amazing culture with smart, collaborative teammates who actually care about each other's growth and success.
  • You will grow more here than you would anywhere else, that is a promise.
  • Virtual events like talent shows, Among Us nights, and online game sessions to keep the fun going, no matter where you are!
  • We offer a highly competitive compensation package.
  • You'll receive a medical allowance to support your health and wellness needs.
  • Flexible working environment and working hours that fit your lifestyle, wherever you're based.

title: Tech Systems Analyst
description:
We are looking for a strong Java Application Support Engineer to join our global Financial Services application support team, made up of team members in the United States, Brazil, and India. This position will sit remotely in Brazil. In this role, you will monitor, troubleshoot, deploy, and debug existing applications. Relational Database experience with SQL, MySQL, Oracle SQL, or PL/SQL experience is preferred. Deployment experience using Jenkins is highly preferred. Our team works in an Agile Scrum environment with daily stand-ups and sprint meetings. You will be a part of an on-call rotation once you are trained on our applications.


Responsibilities:

  • Java application support
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, deploy, and debug existing applications
  • Debug software components, identify, fix, and verify remediation of code defects (own work and the work of others)
  • Support and maintain projects developed by the team and assist in production deployment and outages
  • Configure, deploy, debug, monitor, and document new system features and enhancements using Jenkins
  • Successfully communicate designs, research, and potential issues with team members
  • Collaborate with business professionals to determine functional and non-functional requirements for software development projects.
  • Participate in rotational 24x7 on-call 3rd/4th level support


Qualifications:

  • Associate Degree, or, Technologo (Technologist) Degree, or higher is required.
  • 4+ Years of Java/J2EE application support experience
  • 2+ years of Relational Database experience
  • 2+ years of CI/CD tools (Jenkins)
  • 2+ years of experience on Linux platform
  • Good understanding of Object-Oriented Programming and Design principles
  • Knowledge of the full lifecycle of software development including use of version control tools, build management, unit testing, issue tracking software (e.g. SVN, Git, Maven, Jenkins, JIRA)
  • Excellent organizational skills, self-administration, attention to detail, multi-tasking, and effective prioritization
  • Strong interpersonal and English communication skills
  • Self-motivated and able to meet objectives
  • Experience with the following technologies preferred:
  • Spring/Spring-MVC/Spring Batch/Spring Boot is a plus
  • Tomcat, JBoss
  • REST Services, SOAP Services
  • Relational Database experience
  • JIRA & Confluence
  • Dynatrace & Splunk

title: Finance Manager
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities

  • Oversee daily liquidity positioning in both BRL and digital assets, ensuring the firm meets all operational and regulatory obligations.
  • Maintain rigorous oversight of treasury-related accounting entries, ensuring accuracy in the general ledger and alignment with local Brazilian accounting standards.
  • Maintain accounting practices in strict accordance with the Accounting Standard for Institutions Regulated by the Central Bank of Brazil (COSIF), ensuring all financial statements are audit-ready.
  • Lead the preparation and timely submission of CADOC (Central Bank of Brazil Data Collection) reports, ensuring all financial data transmitted to regulators is accurate and consistent.
  • Implement and monitor ACAM frameworks to ensure the Brazilian entity remains within the risk appetite defined by the Central Bank and global HQ.
  • Develop and execute strategies to minimize idle cash, manage currency exposure (FX), and optimize transaction costs across local banking partners.

title: Calypso Configuration and Environment Management
description:
Project Description:

Luxoft has one of the world's leading Calypso practice.

We are a top-tier Calypso Partner and a market leader in implementation, integration, upgrade, and migration.

We provide end-to-end project services and have delivered Calypso projects across all major asset classes and sectors including investment banking, asset management, corporate treasury, and insurance.


Project Description:

Support and additional build out for a greenfield Calypso instance.


Responsibilities:

  • Develop necessary technical solutions for Calypso environments and instance on the cloud as per requirements
  • Resolve Calypso environment related issues
  • Stabilize Calypso environment with improvements and other services architectural changes
  • Establish a comprehensive and integrated approach to defining, setting up, or trouble shooting issues arising from day-to-day activities on greenfield Calypso instance
  • Create and deliver assigned projects / tasks and revise as appropriate to meet changing needs and requirements
  • Competent in managing and establishing methodology and best practice for Calypso technical requirements
  • Ensures supporting documents are complete, current, and appropriately stored
  • Works closely with relevant business and technology stakeholders to ensure effective and efficient implementation of the project(s)
  • Submits status reports to stakeholders; coordinates and provides updates to steering committees
  • Collaboration with key functional or business stakeholders to achieve clear outcomes/deliverables in relation to the strategic and transformational book of work
  • Manage deliverables ensuring transparency of risks, issues and dependencies that are fully aligned to functional / business owners


You might be acting also as a business analyst as well in order to help the team gathering and writing requirements, acceptance criteria.


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • 5+ years of experience working in Capital Markets and Calypso
  • Environment management, support, and optimization experience on Calypso
  • • Good knowledge of Financial products cross assets
  • • Proven track record of delivery of implementation / migration projects
  • • Proven experience in the development of Calypso integrations, reporting, and other technical aspects
  • Experience of adherence to governance frameworks / implementation and handover to BAU
  • • Comprehensive knowledge of trade flow, trading systems and related concepts and technology, including valuation and client/market risk management
  • • Leadership skills
  • • Excellent analytical skills, understanding of project life cycles, and ability to act in an entrepreneurial manner to ensure the requirements from the business are gathered in the appropriate manner.
  • • Proven analytical, planning, problem solving and decision-making skills
  • • Comfortable with direct communication with all levels of technical and business resources
  • • Excellent organizational and time management skills with the ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously
  • • Experience with working in a highly collaborative and dynamic multi-team environment


Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

  • Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment is essential.
  • Have a willingness to learn new skills
  • Must have attention to detail
  • Must have the ability to work independently and also as part of a group


  • Experience of Agile practices and processes (e.g. SCRUM, KANBAN)
  • Any technical knowledge (Writing simple sql query, be able to read code )
  • Conflict management ensuring collaborative outcomes
  • Excellent attention to detail and accuracy


Languages:

  • English: B2 Upper Intermediate
  • Spanish: C2 Proficient

title: Investment Banking Intern
description:
Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program

Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.


We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.


Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.


What You'll Gain:

  • Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:
  • 3-Statement Financial Modeling
  • Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
  • Trading Comparables (Comps)
  • Precedent Transactions
  • Advanced Excel & PowerPoint techniques
  • Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies
  • Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:
  • Pitch Book Development
  • Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
  • Financial Modeling
  • Sourcing & Due Diligence
  • Industry and Company Research
  • And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
  • Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.


This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.


Who We're Looking For:

This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.


How to Apply:

Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.

This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.

title: Senior Content Manager
description:
As a Senior Content Manager, you will play a key role in supporting MoveUp Media’s growth by owning the operational and strategic execution of content across our website portfolio. You will take ownership of content performance and strategy across our websites, while leading day-to-day content operations and working closely with SEO and cross-functional teams. You will be responsible for turning content and SEO strategies into measurable results, while ensuring high-quality standards across multi-language teams and markets.


This role contributes directly to the CORE department’s objectives by supporting the growth, stability, and diversification of the business through content performance, strong processes, and effective collaboration. You will act as the main point of ownership for content quality and delivery, working closely with SEO, Product, and cross-functional teams.


To be more specific, you will:


  • Lead and develop the content strategy for our flagship, multi-language websites across multiple markets
  • Manage content workflows and ensure consistent, high-quality output across all sites
  • Oversee content quality, structure, and standards across our portfolio
  • Work proactively with content teams to define and implement content checklists and best practices
  • Collaborate closely with SEO, Tech, Design, and Product teams to ensure content and SEO best practices are followed
  • Ensure all SEO and content checks are completed ahead of website launches or redesigns
  • Regularly review websites to identify issues, suggest improvements, and support teams with implementation
  • Monitor content performance and report progress and key initiatives to senior stakeholders
  • Ensure content meets compliance and regulatory requirements and oversee necessary updates
  • Stay up to date with market trends, best practices, and iGaming innovations
  • Support hiring and team development (mentoring) in collaboration with Talent Acquisition and HR.


The ideal profile


We’re looking for a Senior Content Manager ready to step into a Lead role — someone who takes ownership of content performance, works independently, and collaborates closely with SEO to drive results.


You are someone who:


  • Has 3+ years of experience in a senior content or content leadership role
  • Has iGaming experience (a strong plus, not a must)
  • Has a background in journalism, communications, or a related field (a plus)
  • Has an excellent command of English and a strong eye for content quality and consistency
  • Is comfortable reviewing and optimising content rather than writing it


You bring strong CM fundamentals:


  • High level of autonomy and strong task prioritisation skills
  • Ownership mindset over site and content performance
  • Ability to analyse performance data and turn insights into clear actions
  • Strategic thinking and the ability to plan toward defined goals
  • Experience working with CMS platforms


You work well with others and think ahead:


  • Collaborative approach, especially when working with SEO teams
  • Proactive in sharing ideas, flagging issues, and suggesting improvements
  • Open to experimentation, innovation, and continuous improvement
  • Positive attitude with a growth mindset and leadership potential


Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.


Next steps in the process ✅


  • 1rst Interview with your future manager to make sure you meet the role’s requirements
  • 2nd interview with HR to better understand who you are and make sure there is a cultural fit with MoveUp Media
  • Last step: a proposition for us to start working together!


What’s in it for you


  • A full time remote work environment.
  • A flexible schedule and paid time off. We measure results , not hours.
  • Competitive salary, depending on your level of seniority in the role and your location
  • Development opportunities. As a startup with rapid growth, there are a lot of possibilities that can arise and we are committed to accompany our team members in their career path.
  • Yearly get together with the team to connect, work and have fun . We strive to find good spots for everyone to enjoy the stay!


MoveUp Media

title: Analista BI - Remoto
description:
A Getronics é líder global em soluções de tecnologia, com uma equipe de mais de 4.000 colegas em 22 países, fornecendo serviços abrangentes de ponta a ponta em todo o mundo. Temos o compromisso de oferecer um atendimento excepcional ao cliente, para permitir que eles se concentrem em seus principais pontos fortes, enquanto confiam suas necessidades de TI à Getronics. Temos uma oportunidade incrível para você se juntar à nossa equipe, na seguinte vaga:

Analista BI - Remoto.


O que oferecemos a você

- Assistência médica sem desconto para titulares;

- Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares;

- Cartão flex tanto para alimentação quanto refeição;

- Auxílio home office para vaga remota;

- Vale transporte para posições presenciais ou híbridas;

- Auxílio creche;

- Seguro de vida;

- Desconto em terapia: plataforma de apoio psicossocial;

- Parceria com instituições de ensino;

- Parceria com escolas de idiomas;

- Programa de subsídio para aulas de inglês;

- Programa de indicações: prêmio para indicações bem-sucedidas; - Licença maternidade estendida de 180 dias e a licença paternidade de 20 dias;

- Treinamento completo fornecido como parte de um processo de indução robusto, incluindo oportunidades de desenvolvimento contínuo com nossa plataforma de aprendizado online NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy, que possui mais de 80.000 cursos disponíveis;

- GetVibes - nosso programa de escuta ativa que nos permite conectar e ouvir feedback de todos os colegas, e como empresa, trabalhamos juntos para elaborar planos de ação para melhorar e desenvolver continuamente a Getronics!


O que esperar dessa posição:

Atuação no desenvolvimento e melhorias de sistemas bancários.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Proficiência em SQL , com capacidade de realizar consultas complexas
  • Experiência com ferramentas de Business Intelligence (Power BI, Tableau ou similares)
  • Habilidade na criação de relatórios e dashboards gerenciais
  • Conhecimento em análise estatística e testes de hipóteses
  • Capacidade de traduzir dados em insights acionáveis para o negócio




O que fazer em seguida:

Caso você seja a pessoa que estamos procurando, aguarde nosso contato para te conhecermos melhor e siga as instruções durante o processo seletivo. Se você gostaria de fazer alguma pergunta sobre nossas vagas, sobre a Getronics como empresa ou qualquer outra coisa, por favor, não hesite em entrar em contato. A equipe de RH estará disponível no e-mail

Analista BI - Remoto.

- Assistência médica sem desconto para titulares;

- Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares;

Atuação no desenvolvimento e melhorias de sistemas bancários.

title: [Suporte] Analista de Suporte Técnico Pleno | Protheus
description:
Apoiar no suporte técnico do ERP Protheus em Regra de Negócio e Análises técnicas nos módulos Financeiro, Contabilidade Gerencial, Ativo Fixo e Planejamento e Controle Orçamentário.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Realizar o atendimento aos clientes, por meio dos canais TOTVS, esclarecendo suas dúvidas sobre assuntos referentes ao sistema, registrando sugestões e incidentes;
  • Registrar, em sistema, a solicitação do cliente com todas as evidências (tickets abertos) de detalhamento necessárias para todos os impactados;
  • Triar os tickets abertos pelo cliente e reclassificá-los ou categorizá-los, quando necessário, pelo tipo de ticket ou status do atendimento;
  • Fornecer status das demandas em evolução, quando solicitado pelo cliente, por meio de canais de atendimento (telefônico, por e-mail, sistema);
  • Escalonar, para o próximo nível, as solicitações ou incidentes que não forem evoluídos, após o esgotamento das possibilidades de solução dentro do tempo estimado pela Coordenação da área;
  • Contribuir tanto para o cumprimento dos indicadores individuais (produtividade, pesquisa de satisfação e outros) quanto para o resultado/metas da área;
  • Alertar a coordenação e atuar em potenciais riscos ou crises em clientes;
  • Manter atualizados FAQs/banco de conhecimento com as soluções definidas e repassadas aos clientes;
  • Apoiar nos processos de melhorias, detectando novas soluções, identificando problemas e questões relevantes;
  • Realização de consultorias de suporte ou técnicas aos clientes
  • Prestar o atendimento, por meio de canais de abertura de tickets, de acordo com o processo definido e visando ao atendimento e às metas estabelecidas;


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Conhecimento técnico e de negócio nos módulos Financeiro, Contabilidade Gerencial, Ativo Fixo e Planejamento e Controle Orçamentário (PCO);
  • Conhecimento em banco de dados;
  • Linguagem de programação ADVPL;
  • Análise e depuração de código fonte;
  • Conhecimento na arquitetura, instalação e configuração do Protheus;

title: Auditor(a)
description:
VAGA ABERTA: Auditor(a) Sênior – Remoto


Em busca de uma carreira em uma empresa que valoriza a flexibilidade, desenvolvimento pessoal e sucesso da equipe? Com 30 anos de experiência e reconhecidos pelo GPTW pelo quinto ano consecutivo, estamos em busca de talentos para se juntarem a nós como Auditor(a) . Com matriz no Brasil e filiais em território internacional, oferecemos oportunidades para crescimento e desenvolvimento. Candidate-se agora e faça parte de uma equipe que transforma negócios e realiza sonhos!


Requisitos essenciais:


  • Possuir graduação em Tecnologia da Informação ou graduação em qualquer área acompanhada de pós-graduação (especialização, mestrado ou doutorado) em TI, com carga horária mínima de 360 horas;
  • Ter experiência profissional comprovada na área de Tecnologia da Informação;
  • Ter experiência profissional comprovada em auditoria de sistemas e plataformas;
  • Possuir certificação Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA).


Requisitos adicionais:


  • Dominar práticas ágeis, incluindo design incremental, design thinking, planning poker, refatoração, testes automatizados, BDD, TDD, DevOps, programação em par, inspeção e revisão de código, Definition of Ready (DoR) e Definition of Done (DoD), integração e entrega contínuas (CI/CD), propriedade coletiva do código, histórias de usuário, critérios de aceitação, linguagem Gherkin, PDCA, produtização, Infrastructure as Code (IaC) e Configuration as Code (CaC);
  • Conhecer frameworks e referenciais como Manifesto Ágil, Scrum, Kanban, Lean, XP, DevOps, SAFe®, SRE, ITIL, COBIT, AIOps, FinOps, CMMI, MPS.BR e SOx;
  • Ter experiência com nuvens Microsoft Azure e AWS
  • Vivência com ferramentas de inteligência artificial, como ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, plataformas de geração de imagens ou automação de processos, aplicadas a: Automatização de tarefas, criação de relatórios e análise de dados, apoio à tomada de decisão e inovação contínua, melhoria da eficiência operacional e qualidade das entregas.


Responsabilidades:

title: AI Automation Specialist | Ecommerce (Full-time Remote, BR)
description:
Carepod is a growing premium humidifier brand operating in the US, Canada, and Australia . We’re looking for an AI Automation Specialist to eliminate manual work and build smart, reliable workflows across the business.



What You’ll Do


  • Build AI-powered automations for marketing, operation, CS, and reporting system throughout company
  • Connect tools like Shopify, Asana, Google Workspace, Zendesk
  • Design workflows using Zapier / Make / n8n + LLMs like ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, etc
  • Identify inefficiencies and turn them into systems



What We’re Looking For


  • 3+ years in automation / ops / systems roles
  • Hands-on experience with no-code / low-code tools
  • Strong business process thinking
  • Clear English communication
  • Bonus: ecommerce, Python, security-minded builds



How to Apply


  • Apply with your resume or LinkedIn profile.

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Junte-se à nossa equipe como professor de inglês remoto!

Na Flyover Idiomas, nosso diferencial está no processo de junção de alunos e professores, que visa aproveitar suas semelhanças, incluindo experiência e personalidade.

Estamos à procura de pessoas dedicadas e entusiasmadas para se juntarem à nossa equipe como professores de inglês remoto. Esta posição oferece a conveniência de trabalhar de qualquer lugar com horários flexíveis.


Sobre nós:  Somos uma escola de idiomas online comprometida em oferecer ensino de inglês de alta qualidade para alunos de todas as idades e contextos. Nossa missão é ensinar os alunos através de experiências de aprendizagem personalizadas, utilizando a abordagem comunicativa, com foco na fluência mais do que na precisão, selecionando materiais autênticos e relevantes, e integrando todas as quatro habilidades.


Visão geral da posição

  • Lecionar aulas de inglês, principalmente particulares ou em pequenos grupos.
  • Desenvolver planos de aula e atividades envolventes que atendam a diferentes necessidades de aprendizagem e níveis de proficiência, usando a abordagem comunicativa, focada na autonomia do aluno e na personalização da aula.
  • Participar de treinamentos, reuniões com nossos coordenadores e projetos diversos.
  • Fornecer feedback construtivo e ajudar os alunos a melhorar suas habilidades linguísticas.
  • Enviar relatórios das aulas para manter seus alunos e a escola atualizados sobre o andamento das mesmas.
  • Promover um ambiente de aprendizagem confortável e encorajador com foco no sucesso do alu no.


Formato

  • Contratação: Contrato com Microempreendedor Individual (MEI)
  • Local : Remoto
  • Carga Horária: Você define a sua própria agenda


Requisitos

  • Proficiência em inglês (mínimo C1)
  • Bacharel em Inglês, Educação, Linguística ou áreas similares (certificação TESOL/TEFL é um diferencial).
  • Experiência comprovada no ensino de inglês como segunda língua, seja online ou em sala de aula.
  • Disponibilidade de pelo menos 25 horas/semana, com alguns horários após as 17h (horário de São Paulo).
  • Habilidades de comunicação e de relacionamento interpessoal.
  • Conexão de internet estável, computador, webcam, espaço de trabalho privado e silencioso.
  • Familiaridade com plataformas de ensino online.
  • CNPJ / MEI ativo.


Por que se juntar à nós?

  • Flexibilidade: Trabalhe de qualquer lugar com um horário flexível que se adapte ao seu estilo de vida.
  • Impacto: Fazer a diferença na vida dos alunos, ajudando-os a atingir seus objetivos de aprendizagem.
  • Crescimento Profissional: Acesso a oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional e treinamento contínuo para aprimorar suas habilidades de ensino.
  • Comunidade de Apoio: Junte-se a uma equipe de educadores que se dedicam ao sucesso dos alunos e à melhoria contínua.

  • Enviar relatórios das aulas para manter seus alunos e a escola atualizados sobre o andamento das mesmas.
  • Promover um ambiente de aprendizagem confortável e encorajador com foco no sucesso do alu no.


Formato

  • Contratação: Contrato com Microempreendedor Individual (MEI)
  • Local : Remoto
  • Carga Horária: Você define a sua própria agenda


Requisitos

  • Proficiência em inglês (mínimo C1)
  • Bacharel em Inglês, Educação, Linguística ou áreas similares (certificação TESOL/TEFL é um diferencial).
  • Experiência comprovada no ensino de inglês como segunda língua, seja online ou em sala de aula.
  • Disponibilidade de pelo menos 25 horas/semana, com alguns horários após as 17h (horário de São Paulo).
  • Habilidades de comunicação e de relacionamento interpessoal.
  • Conexão de internet estável, computador, webcam, espaço de trabalho privado e silencioso.
  • Familiaridade com plataformas de ensino online.
  • CNPJ / MEI ativo.


Por que se juntar à nós?

  • Flexibilidade: Trabalhe de qualquer lugar com um horário flexível que se adapte ao seu estilo de vida.
  • Impacto: Fazer a diferença na vida dos alunos, ajudando-os a atingir seus objetivos de aprendizagem.
  • Crescimento Profissional: Acesso a oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional e treinamento contínuo para aprimorar suas habilidades de ensino.
  • Comunidade de Apoio: Junte-se a uma equipe de educadores que se dedicam ao sucesso dos alunos e à melhoria contínua.

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Dados  - Vaga afirmativa para pessoas negras
description:
A vaga atual é para o escritório do Brasil e trabalhamos em um modelo Free Office.

Quem somos:

Nós da Artefact LatAm acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact!

Quais serão suas responsabilidades:

Você se juntará à nossa equipe de Dados e Consultoria, que ajuda os clientes a transformar e melhorar sua estratégia de dados aplicando análises avançadas para gerar insights que criam valor de negócio a partir de big data e inteligência artificial.

  • Inovar . Você trabalhará com sua equipe, composta por consultores, cientistas de dados, e engenheiros, para identificar as necessidades dos clientes e definir soluções inovadoras.
  • Aprender e Compartilhar. Você trabalhará em uma equipe colaborativa que promove o compartilhamento de conhecimento. Você aprenderá com outras pessoas, compartilhará conhecimento e ficará a par das novidades/atualizações do setor.
  • Desenvolver. Você participará da solução do início ao fim. Com o auxílio de engenheiros seniores, você gerenciará a concepção e a implementação, além de otimizar o desempenho e a escalabilidades.
  • Atuar em toda a cadeia de valor dos projetos (criação de infraestruturas e plataformas, coleta de dados, aplicação de modelos de aprendizado de máquina, criações de APIs REST, de front-ends, de testes, implementações contínuas).
  • Popularizar termos técnicos ou soluções para perfis mais orientados a negócios, pode trabalhar em uma equipe com perfis muito diversificados.
  • Priorizar suas tarefas, respeitar prazos e se levantar a mão em caso de riscos ou problemas.

O que estamos procurando:

  • Ter cursado graduação em ciência da computação, estatística, engenharia, economia ou uma área relacionada.
  • Curiosidade: você está sempre buscando soluções inovadoras para seus clientes. Você está envolvido em toda a cadeia de valor, que pode ser front-end, back-end, infraestrutura de big data, modelo de ML...
  • Colaboração: o compartilhamento de conhecimento é essencial para você e você participa ativamente da difusão de informações dentro da Artefact.
  • Empreendedorismo: você traz soluções, novas ideias, inovações

O que oferecemos:

  • VR/VT
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
  • Gympass
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós:

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da área de dados.
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender.
  • Cultura: Empatia e Colaboração está no nosso DNA.
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!

Junte-se a nós!

  • Aprender e Compartilhar. Você trabalhará em uma equipe colaborativa que promove o compartilhamento de conhecimento. Você aprenderá com outras pessoas, compartilhará conhecimento e ficará a par das novidades/atualizações do setor.
  • Desenvolver. Você participará da solução do início ao fim. Com o auxílio de engenheiros seniores, você gerenciará a concepção e a implementação, além de otimizar o desempenho e a escalabilidades.
  • Atuar em toda a cadeia de valor dos projetos (criação de infraestruturas e plataformas, coleta de dados, aplicação de modelos de aprendizado de máquina, criações de APIs REST, de front-ends, de testes, implementações contínuas).
  • Popularizar termos técnicos ou soluções para perfis mais orientados a negócios, pode trabalhar em uma equipe com perfis muito diversificados.
  • Priorizar suas tarefas, respeitar prazos e se levantar a mão em caso de riscos ou problemas.

O que estamos procurando:

  • Ter cursado graduação em ciência da computação, estatística, engenharia, economia ou uma área relacionada.
  • Curiosidade: você está sempre buscando soluções inovadoras para seus clientes. Você está envolvido em toda a cadeia de valor, que pode ser front-end, back-end, infraestrutura de big data, modelo de ML...
  • Colaboração: o compartilhamento de conhecimento é essencial para você e você participa ativamente da difusão de informações dentro da Artefact.
  • Empreendedorismo: você traz soluções, novas ideias, inovações

O que oferecemos:

  • VR/VT
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
  • Gympass
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós:

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da área de dados.
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender.
  • Cultura: Empatia e Colaboração está no nosso DNA.

Junte-se a nós!

title: ESPECIALISTA SISTEMAS SAP TM
description:
O Grupo Petrópolis é a única grande empresa do setor cervejeiro com capital 100% nacional. Produz as marcas de cerveja Itaipava, Cabaré, Crystal, Lokal, Black Princess, Petra e Weltenburger, Brassaria Ampolis com os rótulos Cacildis, Biritis, Ditriguis e Forévis, as vodkas Blue Spirit Ice e Nordka, a Cabaré Ice, os energéticos TNT Energy Drink e Magneto, o refrigerante It!, o isotônico TNT Sports Drink e a água Petra. Com oito fábricas em operação e aproximadamente 132 centros de distribuição, o grupo é responsável pela geração de aproximadamente 22 mil empregos diretos.


Por meio dos projetos ambientais, promove o plantio e manutenção de milhares de árvores, além de ações de sustentabilidade e programa de educação ambiental para escolas municipais. Conta também com o Saber Beber, programa comprometido em orientar as pessoas sobre os benefícios do consumo moderado e as consequências do consumo exagerado de álcool.


O respeito é um dos valores do Grupo Petrópolis, e por isso todas as crenças, identidades culturais, gêneros, idades, raças, opções individuais e pessoas com deficiência são respeitadas e valorizadas. Para todas as nossas vagas consideramos candidatos representados por esta ampla diversidade


ATIVIDADES

  • Realizar o suporte as áreas de Supply chain, garantindo a correta execução de seus processos;
  • Fazer alinhamentos e governanças dos atendimentos de chamados com as áreas clientes e TI, buscando melhoras o suporte realizado as áreas de negócio;
  • Elaborar estudos de viabilidade técnica, bem como especificações funcionais e técnicas para soluções de tratativas de causa raiz para erros sistêmicos;
  • Acompanhar os status das demandas e realizar follow-up dos planos de ação, garantindo a execução dos testes pelas áreas de negócio.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com nossos clientes para entender suas necessidades específicas e encontrar as melhores soluções dentro do módulo SAP TM.
  • Apoiar key users, conduzindo treinamentos e orientação funcional.


REQUISITOS

  • Graduação em TI, Ciências da Computação ou Análise de Sistemas;
  • Necessário:
  • Conhecimento em suporte ao módulo SAP TM (Transportation Management)
  • Experiência em suporte AMS no módulo TM nos processos de Planejamento de Fretes através do Sistema SAP TM;
  • Conhecimento aprofundado nos processos de Planejamento de transporte, Freight Order, Freight Agreement e Charge Calculation.
  • Diferencial:
  • Conhecimento em linguagens de desenvolvimento BOPF;
  • Experiência no suporte ao módulo SAP LES/TRA;
  • Conhecimento nas diferentes versões do módulo TM (S4/Hanna);


✅ Benefícios que fazem a diferença:

  • Plano de Saúde

title: Especialista Oracle WMS
description:
Oportunidade: Especialista WMS

Modelo de atuação: Remoto

Requisitos:

- Experiência comprovada com Oracle Warehouse Management (Oracle WMS);

- Experiência sólida com operações de armazenagem e logística (Recebimento, Putaway, Picking, Inventário, Expedição);

- Experiência com desenho de fluxos operacionais;

- Experiência em projetos de implantação de WMS e rollout de centros de distribuição;

- Experiência em metodologias ágeis (Kanban);

- Capacidade de mapear processos logísticos e identificar melhorias;

- Capacidade de traduzir requisitos funcionais para requisitos técnicos;

- Comunicação clara com áreas operacionais e técnicas


Desejáveis:

- Experiência com integração entre Oracle WMS, TMS e Sistemas legados;


Diferencial:

- Experiência com implantação completa de WMS;

- Experiência com automação de CD


Responsabilidades principais:

- Levantamento de requisitos com a área de negócio (Logistica);

Mapeamento de processos: mapear, elaborar e documentar;

- Implantar e realizar o rollout do WMS para os Centros de Distribuição (projeto, construção, desenho, configurações e implantação) - junto com a equipe/squad de TECH de Sistemas de Logística.

title: Banco de Talentos GFT -  Engenharia de Dados
description:
Banco de Talentos | Engenharia de Dados


Estamos construindo um banco de talentos com foco em profissionais de Engenharia de Dados, em diferentes níveis de senioridade (Júnior, Pleno, Sênior e Especialista/Tech Lead), que desejam atuar em projetos complexos, ambientes de alta volumetria e ecossistemas de dados modernos.


Se você busca desafios técnicos relevantes, trabalhar com grandes volumes de dados e construir soluções escaláveis, queremos te conhecer!


O que você poderá fazer por aqui

  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados escaláveis e eficientes;
  • Trabalhar com ingestão, transformação e disponibilização de dados (ETL/ELT);
  • Construir e evoluir arquiteturas de dados modernas (Data Lakes, Data Warehouses, Lakehouses);
  • Garantir qualidade, governança e confiabilidade dos dados;
  • Atuar com processamento de dados em batch e streaming;
  • Integrar diferentes fontes de dados e sistemas;
  • Colaborar com times de dados, analytics, produto e engenharia;
  • Contribuir com boas práticas de engenharia, performance e observabilidade de dados.


O que buscamos

  • Experiência com engenharia de dados e construção de pipelines;
  • Conhecimento em linguagens como Python, SQL e/ou Scala;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de processamento de dados (Spark, Databricks, etc.);
  • Vivência com orquestração de pipelines (Airflow, Prefect, ou similares);
  • Conhecimento em modelagem de dados e otimização de consultas;
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e NoSQL;
  • Experiência com soluções de cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP) voltadas a dados;
  • Familiaridade com mensageria e streaming (Kafka, Kinesis, etc.) é um diferencial;
  • Conhecimento em conceitos de Data Lake, Data Warehouse e arquitetura de dados;
  • Experiência com versionamento de código (Git) e boas práticas de desenvolvimento;
  • Certificações em cloud ou dados (como AWS, Azure, GCP, Databricks, entre outras) serão consideradas um diferencial.


Perfil que valorizamos

  • Pensamento analítico e forte capacidade de resolução de problemas;
  • Proatividade e senso de dono sobre as soluções;
  • Colaboração com times multidisciplinares;
  • Capacidade de atuar em ambientes complexos e em constante evolução;
  • Interesse por inovação, dados e novas tecnologias;
  • Organização e autonomia na gestão do trabalho.


Se identificou? Cadastre-se no nosso banco de talentos e fique por dentro das oportunidades que podem surgir

title: Business-Content Writer - 2026
description:
BR SERVICES is looking for enthusiastic professionals with outstanding business-writing skills


  • TITLE : Business-Content Writer
  • HIRING : Part- or Full-time/contractor
  • LOCATION : Home office/contractor’s premises
  • AREA / MAJOR: Consultancy/Business Planning
  • RESUMES TO :


If you have a strong written English level and want to work from the comfort of your home, this might be the right opportunity. Come and join our amazing team from all over the world!


We are a Brazilian company specializing in enterprise solutions that provides consulting services to clients globally. Our know-how ranges from management, information, technology, and finance. Our client’s vast business field will demand your curiosity and ability to research.  



MAIN TASKS


The main responsibility of the consultants is to produce the business narrative, that is, the descriptive content of Business Plans and other consultancy reports. In addition to being proficient in the grammar and rules of style of the American English, they should have strong writing skills, enabling them to express ideas elegantly and effectively.

The narrative aims to explain the Plan to the reader. Therefore, a Business Plan Document will typically describe the endeavor our client intends to launch, including the products the new company will sell, the region it will reach, the staff it will hire, etc. 


The Business-Content Writer Consultant will work in partnership with a financial consultant to produce and write Business Plans for our clients. These Plans are addressed to Government agencies and ultimately aim to obtain any type of business visa in the target country. Therefore, the following skills are essential:


  • Ability to understand our customer profile and business needs
  • Creative writing, with the ability to craft strategies and arguments, often with little background information.
  • Research relevant industry trends, trajectory, competition, the economics of targeted regions, and benchmark milestones;
  • Analyze the market strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, and threats;
  • Connect and aggregate the ideas;
  • Rearrange them in a cohesive and clear text;
  • Proofread and ensure all-around consistency
  • Finally but not least, meet the deadline.


PROFILE AND COMPETENCIES

MANDATORY

  • >= 18 y. o.
  • Bachelor's degree 
  • Advanced proficiency in English;
  • Exceptional writing skills;
  • Advanced skills in MS Word (/compatible);
  • Beginner to intermediate skills in MS Excel;
  • Ability to meet deadlines;
  • Team-player mentality with excellent communication skills;
  • Passionate and curious with web surfer/effective search skills;
  • Attention to detail;


DESIRABLE

  • Intermediate to advanced skills in MS Excel
  • Intermediate skills in MS PowerPoint
  • Page/Graphic design capabilities
  • Studies in Marketing, Journalism, Letters, English

THE FIRM

BR SERVICES provides consulting services as well as document & linguistic solutions for customers such as companies in many industries, universities, or government agencies

Headquartered in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, BR Services is incorporated with the company name of Lili Schneider Serviços Corporativos Ltda., under the Brazilian corporate taxpayer registry (CNPJ) N° / .


Our portfolio has solutions in two main Streams or Practices


1) CONSULTANCY PRACTICE

Our consultancy team provides business advice in areas such as management, information technology, and finance. Among the various products within the practice, Business Planning stands out as the flagship of the consultancy portfolio.


Our Business Plans chiefly focus on assessing and planning businesses to be established in the United States. They have swiftly become actual roadmaps to success for companies and entrepreneurs in their business expansion or their venture to enter a new business vertical. Our Plans have also served as a bridge to the US market for foreign investors, mostly from Brazil and other Latin American countries.


2) TRANSLATION AND LINGUISTICS PRACTICE


Based on our vast experience delivering premium translation, proofreading, copywriting, and ghostwriting services, we have acquired a solid reputation among corporate clients in Brazil and abroad.


On the other hand, our performance in this area is also specially acknowledged within academia. A reference in the translation of scientific papers, BR SERVICES is an accredited partner for scientific journals and maintains agreements for providing translation services with universities and other teaching institutions.


Our performance in this area is also highly recognized within academia. A reference in the translation of scientific papers, we are a certified partner for the edition, proofreading, and translation of their candidate articles. Moreover, we hold long-term agreements for supplying translation services to universities and other teaching institutions.

title: Senior Golang Engineer
description:
Please note that the project operates in the UK time zone.


We are seeking a dedicated, motivated, and reliable Senior Golang Engineer who is interested in providing innovative software solutions for our clients. Be a part of our team as we continue to deliver high quality products and services. The Senior Go Engineer will be responsible for building backend services in Go in EKS, as well as some Lambdas. The overall project will be centered around providing product data and managing the product life cycle. If you are an open communicator with a passion for learning, love to think outside the box and you are excited about software development, we are looking for you!


RESPONSIBILITIES

• Use your deep expertise in Go and related technologies to develop high-quality, scalable, maintainable software solutions.

• Make technically sound decisions and champion high standards of coding and architecture best practices.

• Develop and maintain software documentation such as technical specifications and design documents.

• Continually enhance the team’s performance by mentoring, code reviews, and improving current processes in the SDLC.

• Troubleshoot and debug software issues as they arise.

• Collaborate within a cross functional team and be able to transform both functional and non-functional requirements into actionable work.

• Manage communication of progress/status to stakeholders.


WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• At least 4 years of professional software development experience.

• Proficiency in Go (Golang), including syntax, semantics, database connectivity, and object-oriented concepts.

• Strong understanding of data structures and algorithms.

• Experience working with Go frameworks such as Gin, Revel, Echo, Beego, etc.

• Strong understanding of web services (HTTP, SOAP, REST, GQL, etc.).

• Terraform, Lambdas, Writing API’s.

• Strong working knowledge of relational databases.

• Experience in troubleshooting issues and root cause analysis.

• A proven track record of delivering high quality and tested software on-time and often.

• An open mind, and the patience to explain issues in a constructive manner.

• Strong communication skills, with at least an intermediate level of English.

• Experience working in distributed, cross functional teams.


NICE TO HAVE

• Kubernetes or EKS.

• Algolia.

• Shopify.

• DynamoDB


Who We Are?

We are a fast growing business and technology consultant company co-founded in 2019. We offer a custom-tailored, white-glove engineering service fit for our clients, because a digital transformation is more than just technology. With a successful track record of being a preferred vendor for Fortune 500 companies and as a trusted partner for some of the industry’s leading companies, our global talent has helped many clients achieve their goals.


What's In It For You

  • We offer 100% remote work
  • Wellness/Fitness package
  • Paid trainings and certifications
  • 22 days of paid leave (27 days in the second year with us)
  • Professional Conferences and Training
  • Global Team Building Activities
  • Access to co-working spaces worldwide


Your applications and referrals are welcome!

• Use your deep expertise in Go and related technologies to develop high-quality, scalable, maintainable software solutions.

• Continually enhance the team’s performance by mentoring, code reviews, and improving current processes in the SDLC.

• Manage communication of progress/status to stakeholders.

• At least 4 years of professional software development experience.

title: Senior NOC engineer (Network engineer)
description:
Join our fast-growing company as an Senior NOC engineer (Network engineer) with C1 level of English language.


It is a remote full-time position.


Schedule: Mon-Fri; 9am-6pm, CET

Starting date:


At Mindy Support you have great opportunity to get:


  • Experience in the international company working with people around the globe;
  • Compensation - $950 (during 2 months of probation period), $1050 + $50 monthly bonus based on KPI after probation
  • Training will be provided by the company and the client;
  • Dynamic work in a young team of like-minded people;
  • Management's attention, support and motivation.




Key Responsibilities:

● Technical Operations: Monitor and manage SD-WAN

connections (Cato, Cisco Meraki) and DIA circuits, ensuring

optimal performance and availability. Act as the escalation point

for complex NOC issues, providing advanced troubleshooting and

resolution. Collaborate with ISPs, vendors, and internal teams to

resolve outages and performance issues in a timely manner.

Support proactive network health monitoring, capacity planning,

and performance tuning. Manage configuration, deployment, and

maintenance of SD-WAN devices and edge routers.

● Leadership & Coordination: Serve as the right hand to the NOC

Team Lead, assisting in team oversight and daily operational

activities. Provide mentorship and training to junior NOC

engineers, improving overall team capabilities. Help coordinate

shift handovers, incident escalations, and service restoration

activities. Contribute to onboarding documentation, runbooks, and

troubleshooting guides.

● Incident Management & Reporting: Lead major incident calls

and coordinate technical response efforts. Ensure detailed

incident documentation, root cause analysis, and follow-up actions

are completed. Generate and analyze network performance and

incident trend reports for management and stakeholders.

● SLA Compliance: Monitor service delivery against SLAs; Drive

incident response efficiency and timely escalation; Investigate SLA

breaches and lead corrective actions

● Network Monitoring: Continuously monitor network performance,

health, and security using various monitoring tools to ensure

uptime and reliability.

● Technical Involvement: Assist with technical tickets, incl.

analysis of speed issues, latency, and site/circuit downtime; Utilize

tools like the CATO management portal to analyze graphs and

metrics; Understand and troubleshoot performance-related

anomalies using technical insight; Serve as a go-to resource for

  • diagnosing recurring or complex network issues


Qualifications:

● Education & Certifications (optional): Bachelor's degree in IT,

Computer Science, or related field (preferred). Certifications like

CCNA, CCNP, MTCNA, CompTIA Network+, or equivalent are a

plus.

● Real experience with SD-WAN technology, Cato sockets, Cisco Meraki,

etc.

● Technical Knowledge: Advanced understanding of networking

protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, BGP, etc.), firewalls, VPNs, and

monitoring tools (e.g., Zabbix, Grafana, etc.).

● Experience: 3-5+ years of experience in a NOC or network

engineering role, with recent experience in a Senior/Lead capacity.

● Troubleshooting Skills: Ability to diagnose and resolve network

and connectivity issues efficiently.

● Monitoring & Incident Management: Experience using NMS

tools, handling alerts, and escalating critical incidents.

● Operating Systems: Familiarity with Windows, Cisco IOS, and

cloud environments.

● Security Awareness: Knowledge of cybersecurity best practices,

intrusion detection, and network hardening.

● Excellent leadership, communication, and analytical skills

●Fluent in English


Mindy Support is a global company. We empower businesses all over the world through providing remote assistants and outsourced teams specialized in customer support, tech support, back office activities, and agile sales and marketing support.


We respect the individuality and culture of each member of our large team, and appreciate the contribution of each employee to support our Customers.


We will be glad to welcome you to our team. Grow your career with Mindy Support!

title: Business Development Manager - LatAm Focus
description:
The Mandate: Forging New Paths to Prosperity


We are seeking a full-time BDM with a proven client portfolio and the confidence to open entirely new markets for our portfolio.


✅ Key Responsibilities:


  • Strategic Client Acquisition: Proactively develop and secure new clients, with a sharp focus on expanding Fa Chai Gaming's presence and securing major deals across Central and South America.
  • Market Intelligence & Strategy: Submit regular, insightful reports on regional business developments and market trends, providing actionable recommendations to guide our strategic decision-making and product adaptation.
  • Ambassador & Host: Represent Fa Chai Gaming at key iGaming exhibitions and industry events, adeptly hosting clients and nurturing new business relationships face-to-face.
  • Relationship Nurturing: Undertake periodic business trips across the region to maintain and deepen strategic client relationships, ensuring high client satisfaction and sustained commercial growth.


What Brings You Fortune (Requirements & Skills)


  • Language Mastery: Demonstrated proficiency in both English and Portuguese (Spanish is a strong plus).
  • Industry Experience: Minimum 3 years of professional sales experience in the online gaming/iGaming B2B sector.
  • Existing Client Resources: Must possess an established and active network of operator contacts within the LatAm market, with a proven ability to convert leads into major commercial partnerships.
  • Industry Preference: Candidates with previous sales or business development experience working for established European or American gaming providers/platforms will be strongly preferred.
  • Market Expertise: A deep understanding of the regulatory landscape, operator needs, and player preferences within the Central and South American market is a strong advantage.
  • Location Advantage: A current base of operations within Brazil or a major LatAm market hub is highly desirable.


Are you ready to build a new empire for Fa Chai Gaming and take the lead in LatAm?


If you have the network, the drive, and the ambition to succeed in a fast-paced environment where growth is the ultimate metric, apply now.

title: Advogado(a) Pleno | Contencioso Cível
description:
Aqui, você não é apenas um número. Você é protagonista.


Atribuímos à lealdade e à parceria os nossos valores mais intrínsecos. Estamos de peito aberto para escutar e construir um resultado coletivo, integrado entre os nossos profissionais e os nossos clientes.


Somos um escritório de advocacia preparado para entender, no detalhe, as necessidades de cada caso, comunicando-se sempre da forma mais clara e inteligível.


Como um escritório abrangente e altamente qualificado , proporcionamos soluções jurídico estratégicas por meio de uma equipe experiente e informada, movida pela atitude de facilitar as vias das soluções jurídicas, com base em informações completas e seguras das tradicionais até as mais inovadoras.


Queremos e conseguimos ser uma extensão estratégica dos nossos clientes, oferecendo as soluções eficientes e duradouras, adaptadas para cada individualidade.


Juntos, nós seguimos na direção de um caminho justo e coerente.


Cargo: Advogado(a) Pleno em Contencioso Cível


Missão do Cargo:

Atuar em casos litigiosos de forma técnica e eficiente, garantindo que os clientes recebam orientação jurídica clara e suporte confiável, contribuindo para a solução dos processos e para a estratégia do escritório.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições:


  • Atuação em casos litigiosos no geral, com exposição a diferentes áreas do contencioso, incluindo família e sucessões.
  • Reuniões com clientes para esclarecimento de dúvidas e alinhamento de estratégias.
  • Elaboração de peças processuais e acompanhamento do andamento dos processos, garantindo qualidade técnica e cumprimento de prazos.
  • Diligências presenciais e levantamento de informações junto a órgãos públicos e tribunais.
  • Suporte à equipe na análise de casos e preparação de documentos jurídicos, mantendo comunicação clara com clientes e colegas.


Requisitos:


  • Formação em Direito (registro ativo na OAB).
  • Experiência prévia em contencioso cível.
  • Boa comunicação e relacionamento com clientes.
  • Organização, comprometimento com prazos e atenção a detalhes.
  • Desejável experiência em família e sucessões.


Benefícios:


  • Salário competitivo;
  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Reembolso de atividade física;
  • Estacionamento ou auxílio mobilidade;
  • Plano de desenvolvimento;
  • Bônus.


Regime de Trabalho

  • Modelo híbrido: 4 dias presenciais e 1 dia remoto .

title: Tech Lead - Full Remoto - PJ
description:
Oportunidade: Tech Lead (Foco em Serviços Financeiros) - Full Remoto - PJ + Beneficios


Você é uma liderança técnica que transita bem entre a visão de negócio e o código? Busca um desafio onde possa arquitetar soluções robustas e, ao mesmo tempo, mentorar talentos em um ambiente dinâmico? Então essa vaga é para você!


Estamos em busca de um Tech Lead para guiar a evolução tecnológica de produtos financeiros, equilibrando excelência técnica com agilidade de entrega.


O Desafio:

  • Liderança de Arquitetura: Tomada de decisão técnica em stacks ecléticas (Go, Java e Mendix ) e escalabilidade em Cloud OCI .
  • Mão na Massa Estratégica: Atuação consultiva, code reviews críticos e resolução de gargalos de performance.
  • Ponte de Negócio: Ser o elo entre Produto e Engenharia para viabilizar serviços financeiros de alto impacto.
  • Desenvolvimento de Pessoas: Disseminar boas práticas e elevar a barra de qualidade do time através de mentoria.


O que buscamos:

  • Experiência sólida como Tech Lead ou Arquiteto .
  • Vivência no setor de Serviços Financeiros .
  • Perfil Multi-stack (Go/Java + plataformas Low-code/Mendix).
  • Experiência com OCI (Oracle Cloud Infrastructure) ou outras nuvens.


Detalhes e Benefícios:

  • Modelo: PJ (180h/mês).
  • Atuação: Remoto (com idas ao escritório apenas sob demanda).
  • CNAE Requerido: 62.01-5-01.
  • Vale Refeição e Vale Alimentação.
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica (SulAmérica ).
  • Gympass.
  • Adicional Anual (conforme política).
  • 8 dias úteis de recesso remunerado.


Boa Sorte !!!

title: Back End Developer With Data Exp
description:
Role: Data Engineer III (API) or Software Engineer with Data Experience

Location: Mexico / Brazil (Remote)

Mode: Contract/FTE


About the Role

We are looking for a senior-level engineer with strong backend and data expertise. The role centers on Node.js, TypeScript, APIs, and database modeling with exposure to cloud services.


Responsibilities

  • Build and manage APIs (REST & GraphQL).
  • Design and optimize data models (MongoDB, NoSQL, relational).
  • Work on schema design, indexing, and transactions.
  • Develop ETL pipelines and data ingestion workflows.
  • Collaborate on backend architecture with containers and cloud (AWS/OCI).


Requirements

  • 6+ years of software/data engineering experience.
  • Strong skills in Node.js, TypeScript, and database modeling .
  • Experience with GraphQL, MongoDB, and NoSQL.
  • Knowledge of software engineering best practices.
  • Cloud (AWS/OCI) and container experience.
  • Excellent communication skills.


Nice to Have

  • Messaging systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ).
  • Event-driven architecture.

title: Senior Salesforce Developer (ISV / OEM Application)
description:
Company Overview


QAT Global is a US-based IT consulting firm with over 30 years of experience delivering high-quality technology solutions to enterprise clients. Our teams operate across the United States, Costa Rica, and Brazil.


Position Overview


We are seeking a Senior Salesforce Developer to design, develop, and maintain a commercial Salesforce OEM/ISV application .

This role involves building scalable Salesforce solutions using Apex and Lightning Web Components while supporting managed package development and AppExchange distribution.

The professional will work directly with US-based clients and collaborate with distributed engineering teams.


Core Technical Skills

  • Apex development
  • Lightning Web Components (LWC)
  • SOQL / SOSL
  • Salesforce Flows
  • Apex Triggers
  • Salesforce data modeling


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop scalable Salesforce application features
  • Build advanced automation using Flows and Apex
  • Maintain and extend managed packages
  • Ensure compliance with Salesforce governor limits and security models
  • Support CI/CD pipelines and release management
  • Implement integrations and data migration processes
  • Collaborate with product managers and client technical teams


Required Experience

  • Strong Salesforce development experience with Apex and LWC
  • Experience combining declarative configuration and custom development
  • Deep understanding of Salesforce security and sharing models
  • Experience with CI/CD and version control
  • Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills


Preferred Experience

  • Experience with managed packages or ISV applications
  • Experience with Experience Cloud / Community Cloud
  • Familiarity with backend systems such as C# or .NET


Certifications (Preferred)

  • Salesforce Platform Developer I
  • Salesforce Platform Developer II
  • Salesforce Platform App Builder


Additional Requirements

  • Professional English communication skills
  • Ability to collaborate with distributed teams
